Application Fee

  • No Application Fee for the Checking CBSE Board Term II Class X & XII Exam Result & Activate Your DIGI Locker Account Through Security Pin.
 

OnlyJobs® :  How to Activate DIGILOCKER Account Through School Security Pin 2026

  • CBSE has issued a notice on 14 April 2026, in which it has been said that the annual board examination year 2026 of class 10 and 12 results / certificates and migration will be through Digilocker.
  • All CBSE Board Class 10 and 12 students who have also appeared in the exam will have to create their own account in Digilocker.
  • CBSE Board students can create their account in Digilocker by following some simple steps - which CBSE has also mentioned in its notice.
  • Once the account is created in Digilocker, candidates can also download their CBSE Board 2026 result, marksheet, certificate and migration online after the issue.
  • Step by Step to Activate CBSE Student to Activate Digilocker Account.
  • Step 1 : The student will get the link to do DigiLocker Account Confirmation in the Some Useful Important Links section at the bottom of this page.
  • Step 2 :To confirm DigiLocker Account, the student has to first select his class such as X or XII.
  • Step 3 : After that the student has to enter the code of his school. If the school code is not known, then they can see it in their admit card.
  • Step 4 : After that the student has to enter his/her board exam roll number.
  • Step 5 : After that Enter 6 Digit PIN provided by your school.
  • Step 6 : After that the candidate has to enter his mobile number.
  • Step 7 : An OTP will be received on the mobile number given by the student, he will have to enter it.
  • Step 8 : DigiLocker Account Confirmation process will be completed.
  • Now waiting for the candidate, whenever the CBSE Board will release the result of 2026 examination, candidates can also check their result through Digilocker as well as download the passing certificate / mark sheet and migration.

How to Check CBSE Board 10th & 12th Results 2026

  • CBSE Board Exam 2026 result can be released anytime in the month of April / May 2026.
  • After the release of CBSE result of board exam, candidates can check their result through two means.
  • After the release of CBSE result, candidates can check their class 10 and 12 result through CBSEResult and Digilocker whose direct link will be found in OnlyJobs Some Useful Important Link of this page.
  • The student must have his/her roll number to view the CBSE Result 2026.
  • All the registered students of CBSE Exam 2026 must activate their Digilocker account.

Follow these simple steps to download your Indian Army Agniveer Admit Card 2026:

How to Apply SSC One Time Registration OTR Online Form 2025

  • Staff Selection Commission SSC issued a notice on 22 February 2024 saying that they have launched a new website SSC Gov in, in which all the candidates will have to do fresh one time registration (OTR)
  • Step 1 : Open the Website ssc.gov.in or Direct Link Will be in this Page Some Useful Important Links Section
  • Step 2 : Click on New Registration Tab
  • Step 3 : Students will have to give their basic information such as: Name, Father's Name, Mother's Name, Mobile Number, Email Id and High School Class 10 Roll Number.
  • Step 4 : Verify Your OTR Profile Details & Submit Registration.
  • Step 5 : An OTP will be received on the registered email and registered mobile number of the candidate, he will have to enter it.
  • Step 6 : The registration Part I process will be completed, the candidate will see the OTR Registration No. on the screen.
  • Step 7 : In the next step, you will have to change the default password which has been received on your email, after that you will have to login by writing the registration number along with the password which has been received on the email.
  • Step 9 : Candidates should change the default password of OTR registration number with their custom password. Use capital letters, small letters, numbers and special characters while creating the new password which should be at least 08 digits. Additionally, two security questions will also have to be selected, so that if you forget your password in future, you can recover your password with the help of the security question.
  • Step 10 :  After changing the password, the candidate will have to login again, after that the information about his nationality, category, Visible Identification Mark and information about permanent and local address will be entered in the form.
  • Step 11 : The last step is that here you have to first double check all the information by clicking on the preview button of OTR, after checking, if there is any error then correct it, otherwise click on the declare button and submit the form finally.
  • Step 12 : The registration process of SSC OTR has now been completed, the candidate will be able to see the dashboard whenever any new recruitment comes, or the candidate can also get the information about admit card and result by logging into the SSC dashboard.
  • Our team has also shown a video on how to do SSC one time registration, which you can watch and do your new registration by following the step by step process: SSC OTR Registration Kaise Kare Video Dekhe
  • For more information, you have to complete the notice issued to SSC OTR.

Indian Army CSBO Grade-II Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details

A total of 190 vacancies have been announced for the post of Civilian Switch Board Operator (CSBO) Grade-II, Group 'C'. These are distributed across UR, SC, ST, OBC, and EWS categories as vertical reservation. CSBO Grade-II 190 12 20

Indian Army CSBO Grade-II Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the closing date of application (31-05-2026). Only citizens of India are eligible to apply. Proficiency in handling Private Board Exchange (PBX) Board with a minimum experience of 6 months is a crucial and mandatory criterion - no application will be accepted without a valid Experience Certificate in handling PBX Board. The post is subject to All India Service Liability including Field Service.

Educational Qualification

Qualification Type Details
Essential Qualification (i) Matric or equivalent from a recognized Board
Essential Qualification (ii) Proficiency in handling Private Board Exchange (PBX) Board with minimum 6 months experience (Experience Certificate mandatory)
Desirable Fluency in spoken English and Hindi

Indian Army CSBO Grade-II Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

Candidates must be between 18 and 25 years of age as on the last date of receipt of application (31-05-2026). The official notification does not specify any application fee for Indian Army CSBO Grade-II Recruitment 2026. No fee details have been mentioned in the Employment Notice. No TA/DA is admissible for appearing in Written Test, Practical Test, and Interview - candidates must make their own arrangements for boarding/lodging at 2 STC, Goa.

Indian Army CSBO Grade-II Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for Indian Army CSBO Grade-II Recruitment 2026 consists of 3 stages - Written Test (100 marks, merit-based), Practical Test (qualifying only), and Interview (qualifying only), followed by a Medical Test for shortlisted candidates. Selection will be made strictly on the basis of merit in the Written Test, subject to the candidate qualifying in the Practical Test and Interview. To reduce the number of candidates for the Written Examination, screening of applications may be carried out based on percentage of marks obtained in Matriculation/10th Board examination.

Stage 1 - Written Test (100 Marks - Merit Based)

Part Subject Type Marks
Part-I General Intelligence & Numerical Aptitude Objective Multiple Choice Type 25
Part-II General Awareness Objective Multiple Choice Type 25
Part-III General English Objective Multiple Choice Type 25
Part-IV Logic & Reasoning Objective Multiple Choice Type 25
Total 100

The question paper will be bilingual (English and Hindi). However, questions of General English subject will be in English only. No extra weightage will be given for additional/extra/higher qualifications.

Stage 2 - Practical Test and Interview (Qualifying Only)

Practical Test To check candidate's proficiency in handling exchange operation - Qualifying in nature only (marks not counted for merit)
Interview Conducted along with Practical Test for qualifying purpose only - marks not counted for final merit

Stage 3 - Medical Test

Medical Test Only shortlisted candidates based on performance in Written Test, Practical Test, and Interview will be directed to undergo Medical Test as per extant Government Orders

Terms of Engagement

Probation Period 2 years probation followed by permanent absorption subject to satisfactory performance
Pension New entrants joining on or after 01 Jan 2004 are governed by the National Pension System
Retention Beyond 55 Years / 30 Years of Service Subject to screening committee approval; retirement from service on attaining age of 60 years if retained
Disqualification Candidate will be disqualified if found to have contracted a marriage while having a living spouse, or entered into another marriage

Indian Army CSBO Grade-II Recruitment 2026 - Exam Syllabus

The Written Test consists of 4 parts - General Intelligence & Numerical Aptitude, General Awareness, General English, and Logic & Reasoning - each carrying 25 marks (total 100 marks), all Objective Multiple Choice Type. The question paper is bilingual (English and Hindi) except the General English section which is in English only. After the Written Test, shortlisted candidates undergo a Practical Test and Interview (both qualifying in nature) to assess proficiency in handling exchange/PBX Board operations.

Part Topic Marks
Part-I General Intelligence & Numerical Aptitude 25
Part-II General Awareness 25
Part-III General English 25
Part-IV Logic & Reasoning 25

Applications must be submitted online only through the official email ID [email protected]. Hard copy applications sent by post will not be accepted. The application window is open from 02-05-2026 (0001 Hrs) to 31-05-2026 (2359 Hrs). Candidates must open the PDF application form in Adobe Acrobat Reader ONLY - do NOT open in browser (Chrome/Edge) as fields may not work. All fields marked with * are mandatory and must not be left blank. All text must be typed in BLOCK LETTERS (CAPITALS).

Candidates should not send their application more than once. Incomplete or wrongly named applications will be rejected without notice. Applications with missing attachments, unsigned forms, or mismatched information will be summarily rejected. Candidates must carry originals of all documents for verification while appearing for examination along with two additional self-attested photographs. For difficulties in filling the application form, candidates may send a screenshot of the issue to [email protected].

  • Experience Certificate in handling PBX/EPABX Board (minimum 6 months duration - mandatory)
  • Residential Certificate
  • Domicile Certificate

Applications must be addressed to: The Commandant, Headquarters, 2 Signal Training Centre, Panaji (Goa) – 403001

South East Central Railway (SECR) Recruitment 2026-27 has been announced for Trade Apprentice (Act Apprenticeship) posts! Published on 05 May 2026 at the official website secr.indianrailways.gov.in, this new recruitment drive offers 1644 openings for eligible candidates. Applicants within the 15 to 24 years age group and possessing a 10th Pass with minimum 50% marks along with ITI in relevant trade can apply online from 05 May 2026 to 04 June 2026. Find all details about the SECR Trade Apprentice new vacancy 2026, including eligibility, online form, and notification PDF here.

FOLLOW US

SECR Raipur Division Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 Notification PDF

The Personnel Department, Divisional Railway Manager (DRM) Office, Raipur, South East Central Railway (SECR) has officially released the Act Apprentice Recruitment Notification (No: E/PB/R/Rectt/Act Appr./01/2026-27, dated 05.05.2026) for engagement of Trade Apprentices under the Apprentices Act-1961 and Apprenticeship Rules-1962 for the year 2026-27. Online applications are invited for engagement as Trade Apprentices in two establishments - DRM Office, Raipur Division (Estt. No. E05202200048) and Wagon Repair Shop, Raipur (Estt. No. E11152200001). A grand total of 1644 vacancies (1363 in Raipur Division + 281 in Wagon Repair Shop) have been announced across multiple designated trades. Online applications are accepted exclusively through the National Apprenticeship Training Portal at https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in from 05.05.2026 to 04.06.2026 (till 23:59 hrs). No physical copy of the application is required to be sent to the office. Candidates are advised to check their eligibility carefully before applying to avoid disappointment at a later stage.

  • Download SECR Raipur Division Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 Notification PDF

Candidates may note that if EWS category seats remain unfilled, they will be filled as per SECR/HQ clarification No. P-HQ/RUL/101/10 (E-50910) dated 13.02.2024.

SECR Raipur Division Act Apprentice Eligibility Criteria 2026-27

Candidates must fulfil both the educational/technical qualification requirements and the age limit to be eligible for this recruitment. The educational qualifications are mandatory and must have already been obtained before the date of notification - candidates appearing in qualifying examinations or awaiting results are not eligible.

The minimum 10th class marks of 50% aggregate is mandatory and the fraction will be applied strictly (e.g., 49.9% will be treated as less than 50%).

ITI qualification must be in the relevant trade from a recognised institution. Candidates are not required to wait for their ITI marksheet if already passed - they must have the actual pass certificate in hand at the time of application. Council Registration (NCVT/SCVT) of the ITI is also required to be verified during document verification.

No Travelling Allowance (TA) or Daily Allowance (DA) will be paid to candidates for any stage of this recruitment process, including document verification.

Category Application Fee
All Categories NIL (No fee mentioned)

SECR Raipur Division Act Apprentice Selection Process 2026-27

The selection of candidates for Act Apprenticeship in SECR Raipur Division and Wagon Repair Shop, Raipur is based purely on merit, with no written examination. The merit list is prepared by taking the average of the percentage marks obtained in both the 10th (Matriculation) examination and the ITI examination, giving equal weightage to both (as per Railway Establishment Rule 201/2017).

The minimum eligibility score for 10th is 50% aggregate. Candidates who qualify in the merit list will be called for document verification, where all original certificates must be produced. If any discrepancy is found between the uploaded documents and originals, or if original documents are not produced, the candidature will be cancelled.

The Railway Administration's decision in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, and mode of selection is final and binding.

Component Weightage
10th (Matriculation) Marks Percentage 50%
ITI Marks Percentage 50%
Basis Average of both (equal weightage)

Contract Selected candidate (or guardian if minor) must enter into a contract of apprenticeship with the employer
Training Period 1 year for each trade, with stipend as per Railway Board rules

How to Apply for SECR Raipur Division Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27

The application process is entirely online through the National Apprenticeship India portal. No physical copy of the application is to be sent to the DRM Office, Raipur Division, or Wagon Repair Shop, Raipur. Candidates must register on the portal, fill in all required details accurately, and upload soft/scanned copies of their recent passport-size colour photograph, signature, and all necessary documents pertaining to educational and technical qualification.

SC/ST/OBC candidates must also upload their recent caste certificate issued by the competent authority in the prescribed format and verify their Aadhaar on the portal. OBC candidates must additionally upload a Non-Creamy Layer Certificate - the OBC certificate must not be older than one year from the closing date of this notification.

PwBD candidates must upload a disability certificate from a Medical Board constituted by the Central or State Government certifying not less than 40% disability. EWS candidates must produce their EWS certificate as per sample Annexure-E at the time of document verification.

  • Apply Online at: https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
  • Application Window: 05/05/2026 to 04/06/2026 (till 23:59 hrs)
  • Upload: Passport-size colour photograph, scanned signature, 10th marksheet, ITI certificate, Caste/EWS/PwBD certificate (as applicable), Aadhaar verification
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates must upload recent caste certificate on the portal and verify Aadhaar
  • No physical application to be sent to the office

Important Instructions for Candidates

Candidates must read all instructions carefully before applying. Applications must be submitted only through the official portal - no other mode of application will be accepted. Canvassing in any form will immediately disqualify the candidate.

No Travelling Allowance or Daily Allowance will be paid to candidates for any stage of the recruitment. If at any stage it is found that a candidate has furnished wrong, fake, or false certificates, the Railway Administration reserves the right to discharge the candidate without notice - even after selection for training.

  • Apply online only at https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
  • No physical copy of the application to be sent to the DRM Office or Wagon Repair Shop.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • Candidates must already hold the required qualifications on the date of notification (05.05.2026) - candidates awaiting results are not eligible.
  • All original documents must be produced at the time of document verification.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for any stage of the recruitment.
  • The Railway Administration's decision in all matters is final and binding.

The Indian Navy has released the official SSC Officer - Executive Branch (Information Technology) Notification 2026 on 05 May 2026 at joinindiannavy.gov.in. A total of 15 vacancies have been announced under the Indian Navy SSC IT Officer Recruitment 2026. Eligible unmarried candidates born between 01 January 2002 and 01 July 2007 with MSc / BE / B.Tech / M.Tech / MCA in eligible IT and Computer Science-related disciplines can apply online from 16 May 2026 to 01 June 2026. The official notification PDF and online application link are available below.

Indian Navy SSC IT Officer Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

The Indian Navy has officially released the recruitment notification for Short Service Commission (SSC) in Executive (Information Technology) Branch - Jan 27 Course, for Special Naval Orientation Course commencing January 2027 onwards at Indian Naval Academy (INA), Ezhimala, Kerala. The notification includes complete details on vacancies, eligibility, age criteria, educational qualifications, selection procedure, training, terms of service, and application instructions. Candidates are strongly advised to download and read the full notification before applying online. The notification PDF and detailed guidelines are available on the official Indian Navy website.

Indian Navy SSC IT Officer Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details

A total of 15 vacancies (tentative) have been announced for the post of SSC Executive (Information Technology) Officer open to both Men and Women candidates. These vacancies may be changed depending on availability of training slots. Only one application can be filled by a candidate - in case of multiple applications, candidature will be cancelled.

Branch / Cadre Total Vacancies Gender
SSC Executive (Information Technology) 15  Men & Women

Indian Navy SSC IT Officer Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the closing date of online application (01-06-2026). Only unmarried Indian citizens are eligible to apply. Candidates must have minimum 60% marks in English in Class X or Class XII. The qualifying degree must be from a University incorporated by an Act of Central or State Legislature in India, or educational institutions established by an Act of Parliament or declared deemed Universities/Autonomous Universities under UGC Act 1956, IIT Act 1961, AICTE Act 1987, NITSER Act 2007, or IIIT Act 2014. Foreign university degrees are also accepted if the institution is recognised by the Government of India or holds an Engineering Degree equivalence certificate from the Association of Indian Universities (AIU Act 1973).

Candidates in the final year of their qualifying degree (regular/integrated) are also eligible to apply. Candidates selected in the final merit list must submit proof of completing the qualifying degree with minimum 60% marks by emailing [email protected] by June 2026. Failure to do so will result in non-permission to join INA, Ezhimala.

Educational Qualification

Option Eligible Streams / Qualifications
Option 1 (Engineering / PG Degree) MSc / BE / B.Tech / M.Tech in Computer Science / Computer Science & Engineering / Computer Engineering / Information Technology / Software Systems / Cyber Security / System Administration & Networking / Computer Systems & Networking / Data Analytics / Artificial Intelligence - with minimum 60% overall marks
Option 2 (MCA) MCA with BCA / BSc (Computer Science / Information Technology) - with minimum 60% overall marks
Mandatory English Requirement Minimum 60% marks in English in Class X or Class XII
NCC Relaxation NCC 'C' Certificate holders (Naval/Army/Air Wing) with minimum 'B' Grade, served for not less than 2 academic years in Senior Division, and certificate not dated prior to 01 Jan 2024 - will get 5% relaxation in cut-off marks for SSB shortlisting

Indian Navy SSC IT Officer Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

Candidates must have been born between 01 January 2002 and 01 July 2007 (both dates inclusive) to be eligible for this recruitment. There is no separate category-wise age relaxation for this entry. The age eligibility is determined strictly by the date of birth as recorded in the Matriculation/10th Certificate. Candidates outside this birth date range are not eligible under any circumstances.

Category Age / Date of Birth Criteria
All Candidates (Men & Women) Born between 01 January 2002 and 01 July 2007 (both dates inclusive)

Indian Navy SSC IT Officer Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

The official notification does not specify any application fee for Indian Navy SSC IT Officer Recruitment 2026. Candidates are advised to check the official Indian Navy website at www.joinindiannavy.gov.in at the time of applying for the latest fee-related instructions. All communications must be made through the official Indian Navy website and portal only.

Indian Navy SSC IT Officer Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for Indian Navy SSC IT Officer Recruitment 2026 consists of 3 stages - Shortlisting based on normalised marks in qualifying degree, SSB Interview, and Medical Examination. There is no written examination. Marks obtained in the qualifying degree will be normalised using formulae available at https://www.joinindiannavy.gov.in/files/normalisation.pdf. The final merit list is prepared based on SSB marks. Candidates declared fit in the medical examination will be appointed subject to police verification, character verification, and availability of vacancies.

Mere inclusion in the Select List/Merit list does not confer a vested right to appointment. Empanelment is not to be treated as final selection and is not an enforceable claim to the post.

Stage 1 - Shortlisting for SSB Interview

Criteria Details
Basis of Shortlisting Normalised marks obtained in the qualifying degree
For BE / B.Tech Candidates Marks obtained up to 5th semester (for regular courses) / 7th semester (for integrated courses) will be considered
For MSc / MCA / M.Tech Candidates All semesters (completed candidates); marks up to pre-final year (final year candidates)
NCC 'C' Certificate Holders 5% relaxation in cut-off marks for SSB shortlisting (subject to eligibility conditions)

Stage 2 - SSB Interview

Criteria Details
SSB Interview Shortlisted candidates will be called for SSB Interview; details available at www.joinindiannavy.gov.in
Travel Allowance AC 3-tier rail fare admissible for SSB interview if appearing for the first time for this type of commission
Change of SSB Centre Not permissible under any circumstances
Merit List Basis Final merit list prepared based on SSB marks only

Stage 3 - Medical Examination

Medical Examination All candidates recommended by SSB are required to undergo medical examination as per Indian Navy standards. No relaxation in medical standards on any grounds. Change of medical hospital/centre is not permissible under any circumstances.

Terms of Service

Initial Commission Period 10 years Short Service Commission
Extension (Maximum) 4 years in 2 terms (2 years + 2 years) subject to service requirement, performance, medical eligibility and willingness
Maximum Service Period 14 years (extension beyond 14 years not granted)
Permanent Commission Not applicable for this entry
Probation Period 2 years from date of grant of rank of Sub Lieutenant (or completion of initial training, whichever is later)

Indian Navy SSC IT Officer Recruitment 2026 - Exam Syllabus

There is no written examination for this recruitment. Shortlisting is based on normalised marks in the qualifying degree. The SSB Interview assesses the candidate's Officer Like Qualities (OLQ), intelligence, psychological suitability, and overall personality. Detailed SSB procedure is available on the Indian Navy website www.joinindiannavy.gov.in. The normalisation formula used for shortlisting is available at https://www.joinindiannavy.gov.in/files/normalisation.pdf.

How to Apply for Indian Navy SSC IT Officer Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the Indian Navy official website www.joinindiannavy.gov.in when the application window opens from 16-05-2026 to 01-06-2026. Hard copy applications will not be accepted. To save time during the application submission window, candidates can fill in their details and upload documents in advance. The application once submitted is final - no request for amendments or changes will be entertained.

Personal particulars must be filled exactly as they appear in the Matriculation Certificate. Aadhaar Card issued by UIDAI is mandatory. All documents must be scanned in original JPG/TIFF format. If any scanned document is not legible or readable, the application will be rejected. Candidates must take a printout of the submitted application and carry it while appearing for the SSB interview.

Documents / Information Required at the Time of Online Application:

  • Aadhaar Card (mandatory - issued by UIDAI)
  • Valid and active Email ID and Mobile Number (mandatory - must not be changed until selection process is over)
  • Matriculation (10th) and Class XII certificates (for date of birth and English marks proof)
  • Mark sheets up to 5th & 7th semester (regular/integrated BE/B.Tech) or all semesters (completed degree) or pre-final year marks (final year PG students)
  • CGPA conversion formula certificate (for BE/B.Tech candidates)
  • NCC 'C' Certificate (if applicable) issued by National Cadet Corps
  • Recent passport size colour photograph (JPG/TIFF format, original)

Post-Selection Document Required: Selected candidates must submit proof of completing qualifying degree with minimum 60% marks by emailing [email protected] by June 2026.

Apply Online at: https://www.joinindiannavy.gov.in

Important Instructions for Indian Navy SSC IT Officer Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only unmarried Indian citizens (Men & Women) born between 01 January 2002 and 01 July 2007 are eligible to apply.
  • Minimum 60% marks in English in Class X or XII and minimum 60% overall in qualifying degree is mandatory.
  • Only one application can be submitted - multiple applications will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • No hard copy applications will be accepted - online submission only via www.joinindiannavy.gov.in.
  • Application once submitted is final - no amendments or changes will be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Change of SSB Centre for examination or interview is not permissible under any circumstances.
  • There is no relaxation in medical standards on any grounds; change of medical hospital/centre is not permissible.
  • Any candidate who is found to be married or marries while under training will be discharged from service and shall be liable to refund full pay, allowances, and training expenditure.
  • Use or possession of narcotics is banned - candidates may be tested for drugs during SSB selection, medical, training, and subsequently during service.
  • All candidates recommended by SSB must undergo compulsory medical examination as per Indian Navy standards.
  • All officers/cadets will be compulsory members of the Naval Group Insurance Scheme (NGIS).
  • Police verification and character verification are part of the final appointment process.
  • Candidature will be cancelled at any stage of selection/training/post-commissioning in case of false declaration, misinformation, or concealment of information.
  • Candidates are advised to regularly check www.joinindiannavy.gov.in for updates on the recruitment process.
  • All decisions of the Indian Navy regarding eligibility, selection, and other matters are final and binding.

BPCL Entry Level Profiles Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates must fulfil the essential educational qualification and minimum work-experience as on 01.04.2026.

Junior Executive (Engineering):

  • Educational Qualification: Diploma in Engineering (3-year course) in Mechanical / Electrical / Instrumentation / Electronics / Civil / Chemical Engineering from a recognized University with minimum 55% aggregate (relaxed to 50% for SC/ST/PwBD).
  • Work Experience: Minimum 5 years of continuous post-qualification relevant work experience (including minimum 1 year in managerial/supervisory role) in sectors like POL Terminal/Depot, LPG Bottling Plant, Pipeline, Refinery, Petrochemical, etc.

Junior Executive (Accounts)

  • Educational Qualification: Graduate in any discipline with minimum 55% + Inter CA / Inter CMA.
  • Work Experience: Minimum 5 years of post-qualification relevant experience in finance function.

Junior Executive (Wayside Amenities)

  • Educational Qualification: B.Com / BBA / B.Sc / BMS / BHM with minimum 55% (relaxed to 50% for SC/ST/PwBD).
  • Work Experience:  Minimum 5 years of relevant post-qualification experience (at least 3 years in Facility Management / QSR / Retail / Hospitality, etc.).

Secretary

  • Educational Qualification: Class X + Class XII + Bachelor's Degree (3-year course) with minimum 55% in each (relaxed to 50% for SC/ST/PwBD).
  • Work Experience: Minimum 5 years as Secretarial Assistant / Secretary or similar roles.

Associate Executive (Quality Assurance)

  • Educational Qualification: M.Sc (Chemistry) with specialization in specified branches with minimum 60% (relaxed to 55% for SC/ST/PwBD).
  • Work Experience: Minimum 3 years post-qualification relevant work experience in laboratory in Petroleum / Oil & Gas / Petro-Chemical / Chemical industry.

Associate Executive (Official Language Implementation)

 

  • Educational Qualification: Master’s in Hindi (2-year course) with minimum 55% (relaxed to 50% for SC/ST/PwBD) + English studied in Class XII / Graduation with minimum 55%.
  • Work Experience: Minimum 3 years of post-qualification work experience in translation (English ↔ Hindi).

Common Note for All Profiles

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible.

BPCL Entry Level Profiles Selection Process 2026

  • Multi-stage selection process may comprise Application Screening, Written / Computer Based Test, Case Based Discussion, Group Task, Personal Interview etc.
  • Provisional selection based on Relevant work-experience, Significant on-the-job achievements, Performance in various selection processes.
  • Final appointment subject to successful completion of Pre-Employment Medical Examination.

How to Apply for BPCL Recruitment 2026

Candidates must apply ONLINE only through the official BPCL website. No other mode of application will be accepted. The online application process is open from 18 April 2026 to 24 May 2026 (23:59 hrs).

Step-by-Step Application Process

  1. Check Eligibility: Ensure that you meet all the eligibility criteria including educational qualification, age limit, and work experience before applying. No eligibility-related queries will be entertained.
  2. Keep Documents Ready: Prepare scanned copies (PDF format) of the following documents:
    • Date of Birth Proof (Class 10th/12th Certificate)
    • Educational Qualification Certificates (Marksheet + Degree/Diploma)
    • Work Experience Certificates (with job role, duration, salary, etc.)
    • Caste/Category Certificate (if applicable)
    • Recent Passport Size Photograph (latest, not older than April 2026)
    • Scanned Signature (not in CAPITAL letters)
    • Last 3 Salary Slips (combined in one PDF)
  3. Register Online:
    • Visit the BPCL Careers page and click on “Apply Online”
    • Click on “New Registration”
    • Enter Name, Email ID, and Mobile Number
    • Note the Registration Number and Password generated
  4. Fill Application Form:
    • Login using credentials
    • Fill personal, educational, and experience details carefully
    • Use “Save & Next” to verify details
  5. Upload Documents: Upload photograph, signature, and required documents as per prescribed format.
  6. Preview Application: Carefully review all details using the Preview Tab before final submission. No changes will be allowed after submission.
  7. Pay Application Fee:
    • Pay via Debit Card / Credit Card / UPI / Net Banking
    • Ensure payment status shows “Completed”
    • Take a printout of payment receipt
  8. Final Submission: Click on “Submit” to complete the application process.

Important Instructions

  • Apply only once; multiple applications may lead to rejection.
  • No hard copy of application needs to be sent to BPCL.
  • Ensure all details match original documents; mismatch may lead to disqualification.
  • Keep your registered email ID and mobile number active for future communication.

BPCL Entry Level Profiles Online Application Form

Eligible candidates who wish to apply for the BPCL Entry Level Profiles can do so by submitting their application form online through the official BPCL website. The application process for the BPCL Recruitment 2026 is completely online, and candidates must ensure that they complete all steps before the deadline.

The online application process for the BPCL Entry Level Profiles Recruitment 2026 is available through the BPCL portal. Eligible candidates are encouraged to fill out the application form and submit the required documents before the last date.

Click Here to Apply Online for BPCL Entry Level Profiles Recruitment 2026

Designation Pay Scale* Approx. CTC at the minimum of Pay Scale
Junior Executive & Secretary Post 30,000-1,20,000 ₹12.28 Lakhs per annum
Associate Executive 40,000-1,40,000 ₹17.11 Lakhs per annum

Candidates will be inducted at the minimum of the pay scale. In addition to Basic Pay, Dearness Allowance (IDA pattern), HRA (if applicable), Perks & Allowances, Retirement Benefits and Performance Related Pay will be payable as per Corporation’s policy.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • The cutoff date for age, qualification, and experience is 01 April 2026.
  • All qualifications must be from AICTE/UGC recognized institutions.
  • Marks should be calculated on total aggregate; no rounding off allowed.
  • CGPA must be converted into percentage as per university norms.
  • Only post-qualification experience will be considered.
  • Internship/training during studies will not be counted.
  • Candidates must fill the application form carefully; details once submitted are final.
  • No changes will be allowed after final submission.
  • Submit only one application; latest application will be considered if multiple are submitted.
  • Candidates working in Govt/PSU must produce NOC during selection.
  • Shortlisting is provisional and subject to document verification.
  • Ineligible candidates at any stage will be disqualified.
  • All communication will be done via registered email only.
  • Selection process participation does not guarantee final selection.
  • Updates/corrigendum will be available only on the official website.
  • Travel Allowance (TA) will be provided as per rules for eligible candidates.
  • BPCL reserves the right to cancel/modify recruitment or change vacancies.
  • Providing false information will lead to disqualification.
  • Canvassing or external influence will result in rejection.
  • Apply only through the official portal; beware of fraudulent agents.
  • Any dispute will be subject to Mumbai jurisdiction.

NHIDCL Deputy Manager Technical Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the closing date of online application (08-06-2026). Candidates must be Indian Citizens or subjects of Nepal/Bhutan. A valid GATE score in Civil Engineering for the year 2024, 2025, or 2026 is mandatory - candidates without a valid GATE score are not eligible to apply.

The educational qualification must be from a University/Institute recognized by AICTE/UGC/State Technical Boards. Candidates must possess the prescribed minimum qualification on the closing date of application submission; admission at all stages is provisional and subject to eligibility verification.

Nationality Indian Citizen or a subject of Nepal/Bhutan

Candidates must not exceed 34 years of age as on the closing date of application (08-06-2026). Age relaxations are available for reserved and other specific categories as specified below. NHIDCL Deputy Manager Technical Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

The official notification does not specify any application/recruitment fee for NHIDCL Deputy Manager (Technical) Recruitment 2026. Candidates are advised to check the official NHIDCL website and recruitment portal at the time of applying for the latest fee-related instructions. All correspondence shall be made only via email at [email protected].

NHIDCL Deputy Manager Technical Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for NHIDCL Deputy Manager (Technical) Recruitment 2026 is based entirely on the best valid GATE score in Civil Engineering obtained in any of the years 2024, 2025, or 2026. There is no separate written examination. Candidates are advised to provide the best of their GATE scores in the online application form. A merit list shall be prepared by the Selection Committee/Recruitment Authority and notified on the company website as per NHIDCL Cadre Rules.

Selected candidates will be allocated to State Groups through a counselling session based on the principle of Merit-cum-Choice. NHIDCL Cadre Rules, 2025 (Rule 6.5 and Rule 6.6) shall apply for placement details.

Selection Based on GATE Score

Criteria Details
Basis of Selection Best of valid GATE Score in Civil Engineering (2024/2025/2026)
No Written Test No separate written examination will be conducted
Tie-Breaking Rule 1 Chronological order of date of birth (oldest candidate preferred)
Tie-Breaking Rule 2 Alphabetical order of first names as appearing in 10th Certificate (if DOB is also same)

Placement - State Group Allocation

State Group States / UTs
State Group-1 Assam, Manipur & Nagaland
State Group-2 Arunachal Pradesh, Meghalaya & Mizoram
State Group-3 Tripura, Sikkim, West Bengal (North Bengal) & Andaman and Nicobar Islands
State Group-4 Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh, Uttarakhand & Himachal Pradesh

How to Apply for NHIDCL Deputy Manager Technical Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the NHIDCL Recruitment Portal, accessible on the official website https://www.nhidcl.com under the Recruitment Section. Hard copy applications will not be accepted under any circumstances. The online portal will be active from 09-05-2026 (10:00 AM) to 08-06-2026 (5:00 PM). Candidates must ensure their Name and Date of Birth are entered exactly as they appear on records during portal registration.

All documents uploaded as specified in the online application must be legible and valid. The Application Acknowledgement and supporting documents must be retained by candidates for verification prior to Offer of Appointment. NHIDCL will communicate solely via email - candidates must provide correct, active email addresses and keep their email ID active for at least one year. No change in registered email ID will be allowed.

Documents to be Submitted at the Time of Document Verification (on being called):

  • Age proof - 10th Certificate or Birth Certificate
  • Educational qualifications - Degree certificate in Civil Engineering
  • GATE Score Card (2024/2025/2026) - candidates must retain their GATE login credentials (Enrollment ID, email ID, password, mobile number)
  • SC / ST / OBC (NCL) / EWS / PwBD certificate (if applicable)
  • Ex-Serviceman Discharge Certificate (if applicable)
  • Government/PSU employees - NOC / Relieving Letter from current organization
  • Application Acknowledgement copy

All correspondence shall be made only via email at: [email protected]. Any other mode of correspondence shall not be valid. Selected candidates, before joining, shall be required to furnish a Non-transferable Service Bond for Rs. 5 Lakhs valid for two years on Non-Judicial stamp paper of Rs. 100.

Apply Online at: https://www.nhidcl.com

Important Instructions for NHIDCL Deputy Manager Technical Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Candidates must be Indian Citizens or subjects of Nepal/Bhutan with a valid GATE score in Civil Engineering (2024/2025/2026).
  • Candidates must possess the prescribed minimum qualification on the closing date of application.
  • No hard copy applications will be accepted - online submission only via NHIDCL Recruitment Portal.
  • Reserved category candidates applying for unreserved posts will not be eligible for any relaxations.
  • Government/PSU candidates must submit NOC/relieving letter at the time of document verification - no pay protection or past service benefits on joining.
  • Canvassing or external influence will disqualify the candidate from selection.
  • Candidates should avoid middlemen, recruitment agents, consultants, and fraudulent job promises.
  • Corrigendum/addendum/errata/updates will be posted only on NHIDCL's website under "Recruitment" (Career - current vacancies).
  • Candidates must keep their email ID active for one year - no change in registered email ID will be allowed.
  • All appointments are subject to successful completion of a Background Verification Process (BGV).
  • Selected candidates must pass a medical test and obtain a medical fitness certificate from a Medical Board of State/Central Government Hospital before joining.
  • Selected candidates are required to undergo a two-year probation period, extendable up to a maximum of two more years.
  • All disputes are subject to Delhi High Court jurisdiction, with the English version prevailing for interpretation.
  • NHIDCL at any stage may cancel the advertisement or selection process without assigning any reasons.
  • For detailed information, refer to NHIDCL Cadre (Recruitment, Promotion & Seniority) Rules, 2025 available on the NHIDCL website.

Application Mode Email only — [email protected]

Event Date
Date of Issue of Vacancy Notice 02/05/2026
Closing Date for Application Submission 22/05/2026
Age Calculated As On 22/05/2026 (Closing date of notification)
Interview / Document Verification Date To be intimated to shortlisted candidates

RLDA Site Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details

A total of 40 vacancies (tentative) have been announced for the post of Site Engineer on contract basis, distributed across Civil and Electrical disciplines for RLDA's Pan-India projects.

Post Name Department No. of Posts
Site Engineer (Civil Engineering) Civil 30
Site Engineer (Electrical Engineering) Electrical 10
Total (Tentative) 40

Note: RLDA reserves the right to modify, restrict, increase or decrease the number of posts or cancel the engagement process at any stage.

RLDA Site Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the closing date of application (22/05/2026). All qualifications must be from a recognized University/Institution approved by AICTE/UGC/Government of India. Only full-time regular courses shall be considered. Experience shall be counted after acquiring the minimum prescribed qualification. Internship/Apprenticeship/Training/Teaching/Academic/Freelancing experience shall not be treated as qualifying experience.

Educational Qualification

Qualification Details
Minimum Educational Qualification B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering or Electrical Engineering from a recognized University/Institute with minimum 55% marks (50% for SC/ST candidates)
Post-Graduation (Desirable) M.Tech qualification — additional weightage will be given during selection
Minimum Work Experience Minimum 02 years of post-qualification experience in Central Govt. / State Govt. / Central Govt. PSUs / State Govt. PSUs / Other Private Organizations in relevant field of Construction / Development / Electrical work / MEP etc.
Desirable / Preferred Skills Experience in Building Construction works

RLDA Site Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

Maximum age limit is 45 years as on 22/05/2026 (closing date of the notification). Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India guidelines for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/Ex-Servicemen/PwD candidates. If a candidate is eligible for age relaxation on two or more grounds, only the highest admissible age relaxation shall be applicable.

Category Age Limit
General / Unreserved (UR) Maximum 45 years as on 22/05/2026
SC / ST / OBC (NCL) / Ex-Servicemen / PwD Relaxation as per Government of India guidelines
Multiple relaxation grounds Only the highest admissible relaxation shall apply (no cumulative relaxation)

RLDA Site Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

No application fee is required for this recruitment. All eligible candidates may apply free of charge by submitting their application via the designated email ID.

Category Application Fee
All Categories (UR / SC / ST / OBC / PwD / EWS) NIL (No application fee required)

RLDA Site Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection will be made on the basis of shortlisting followed by an Interview. In case the total number of applicants is high, RLDA will shortlist candidates based on the selection criteria given below, and only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview. Engagement shall be purely on contract basis for an initial period of up to one year, extendable as per project requirement and satisfactory performance. One-month advance notice shall be required from either side for termination of contract.

Shortlisting / Selection Criteria

Parameter Details
Last drawn Gross Salary Weightage given
Relevant Work Experience Minimum 02 years in Civil Construction / Project Supervision — weightage given
Academic Performance Percentage marks in B.Tech (Civil / Electrical Engineering)
Post-Graduation Additional weightage for M.Tech qualification
Govt./PSU/Railways Experience Additional weightage for candidates who directly worked in Indian Railways / Central PSU / State PSU / Govt. Dept. for a minimum cumulative period of 01 year
Interview Only shortlisted candidates will be called

Tie-Breaking Rules

Assessment Authority RLDA reserves the right to assess candidates as per organisational and project requirements

How to Apply for RLDA Site Engineer Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted via email only to [email protected] and also by post to the RLDA address. Hard copy applications sent without the email will not be considered. The last date for receipt of applications is 22/05/2026. Candidates must fill the Application Form (Annexure-I) in block letters using a blue ball pen and attach all required documents as per the Annexure-II checklist. All documents and the application must be signed by the candidate on each page.

Candidates working in Government/PSU/Autonomous bodies shall give an undertaking regarding no dues or produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of interview. Candidature shall be provisional and subject to verification of documents and eligibility conditions.

Documents to be Submitted Along with Application:

  • Filled Application Form (Annexure-I) - in block letters, blue ball pen
  • Checklist (Annexure-II) - duly filled and signed
  • Matriculation Certificate (age proof)
  • Degree certificates and mark sheets (full set, all semesters)
  • Experience certificates indicating nature and duration of work
  • Category certificate — SC / ST / OBC-NCL / EWS (if applicable)
  • Last three months' payslips and Form-16 of last Financial Year (2025-26)
  • Photo ID and address proof
  • Four recent passport size photographs
  • NOC / forwarding letter from current employer (if working in Govt./PSU/Railways on regular basis)
  • One copy of updated CV

Documents to be submitted by email to [email protected] and also to: Deputy General Manager/HR, Rail Land Development Authority, Unit No. 702-B, 7th Floor, Konnectus Tower-II, DMRC Building, Ajmeri Gate, Delhi-110002. Phone: 011-23232854 / 011-23232835.

Apply via Email: [email protected]

Important Instructions for RLDA Site Engineer Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • This engagement is purely temporary and contractual in nature — selection does not confer any right for regular employment in RLDA.
  • Only full-time regular degree courses from AICTE/UGC/Government of India recognized institutions shall be considered.
  • Internship, Apprenticeship, Training, Teaching, Academic or Freelancing experience shall not be treated as qualifying experience.
  • No application fee is required. Candidates are advised to beware of touts or unscrupulous elements claiming to facilitate engagement through influence or illegal means.
  • Govt./PSU employees must produce NOC or apply through proper channel.
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates must submit a caste certificate issued during the current financial year (2025-26) clearly indicating non-creamy layer status.
  • EWS candidates must produce an Income and Asset Certificate for 2024-25 issued during the current financial year.
  • Selected candidates will be posted at any RLDA project location across India as per its requirement.
  • Candidates must be medically fit and shall undergo medical examination at their own cost before joining.
  • A police verification and clearance certificate shall be submitted before joining by selected candidates.
  • No travelling, lodging or boarding expenses shall be reimbursed for attending the interview.
  • Furnishing false/tampered documents or any misconduct will invite legal action, disqualification, debarment and/or termination.
  • A candidate who refuses to join after issue of offer of appointment will be debarred from all future assignments in RLDA.
  • Any dispute arising out of this notice shall be subject to the jurisdiction of Courts at New Delhi only.
  • Candidates are advised to regularly visit https://rlda.indianrailways.gov.in under the Career section for any corrigendum, clarification or update.
  • No correspondence shall be entertained from candidates found ineligible or not selected.

The latest Central Bank of India (CBI) Recruitment 2026 has been announced for Assistant General Manager (AGM) - Specialist Category posts! Applicants within the 33 to 45 years age group and possessing qualifications such as CA/CFA/CMA, MBA/PGDM, B.E./B.Tech, PG degree/diploma, or relevant specialist certification with required experience can apply online from 30 April 2026 to 17 May 2026. Central Bank of India AGM Specialist Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

Central Bank of India, a leading Public Sector Bank with PAN India branch network of more than 4500 branches and total business of more than Rs. 8,12,000 Crores, has officially released a Recruitment Process Notification for selection of 15 Assistant General Manager (AGM) in Specialist Category in Risk Management, Finance & Accounts and Credit (Scale V). The notification includes complete details on vacancies, eligibility criteria, educational qualification, experience, age limit, selection process, examination pattern, application fee, and application instructions. Candidates are strongly advised to read the full notification carefully before applying online. The notification PDF is available on the official Central Bank of India website.

  • Download Central Bank of India AGM Specialist Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF

Central Bank of India AGM Specialist Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details

A total of 15 vacancies have been announced for the post of Assistant General Manager (Scale V) in Specialist Category. These are distributed across SC, ST, OBC, EWS and UR categories as follows. The number of vacancies is provisional and may vary according to actual bank requirement. Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD (Divyangjan) categories is applicable as per Government of India guidelines.

Sr. No. Post Scale Total
1 Risk Management
i Risk Management V 2
ii Compliance / Risk Management 1
iii Asset Liability Management 1
iv Digital Risk & Analytics 1
2 Finance & Accounts 5
3 Credit Officer 5
Total 15

Central Bank of India AGM Specialist Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the cut-off date 31-03-2026. All educational qualifications must be from a university recognized by Govt. of India / approved by Govt. Regulatory Bodies. Any experience of less than 6 months in an organization shall not be considered for determining eligibility, except when such experience is part of current employment. The post-wise educational qualification and experience requirements are as follows:

Post-wise Educational Qualification, Experience and Age Limit

Post Name Essential Educational Qualification Additional/Mandatory Certification Experience
AGM - Risk Management (Scale V) Full-time B.Sc in Statistics/Economics / Bachelor's in Analytics (Statistics, Applied Maths, OR/Data Science) with 55% marks OR Full-time MBA Finance/Banking or PGDBM/IPGD-Risk Management with 55% marks - from AICTE/UGC approved University. Mandatory: FRM (GARP USA) / CFA (CFA Institute USA) / PRM (PRMIA USA). Preferable: Certification in SPSS/SAS, R, Python. Minimum 10 years in Banking (Officer Cadre), out of which minimum 5 years in Risk Management in scheduled commercial banks having more than 2000 branches. Current role must be Chief Manager with min. 1 year OR min. 4 years as Senior Manager.
AGM - Compliance / Risk Management (Scale V) Full-time B.Sc in Statistics/Economics / Bachelor's in Analytics with 55% marks OR Full-time MBA Finance/Banking or PGDBM/IPGD-Risk Management with 55% marks - from AICTE/UGC approved University. Mandatory: FRM (GARP USA) / CFA (CFA Institute USA) / PRM (PRMIA USA). Preferable: Certification in SPSS/SAS, R, Python. Minimum 10 years in Banking (Officer Cadre), out of which minimum 5 years in Risk Management/Compliance Dept. in scheduled commercial banks having more than 2000 branches. Current role must be Chief Manager with min. 1 year OR min. 4 years as Senior Manager.
AGM - Asset Liability Management (Scale V) Full-time BE/B.Tech OR Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in Business Management/Banking/Finance OR Chartered Accountant. Mandatory: FRM (GARP) / PRM (PRMIA USA) / CFA (CFA Institute). Minimum 10 years in Banking (Officer Cadre), out of which minimum 5 years in Risk Management in scheduled commercial banks having more than 2000 branches. Current role must be Chief Manager with min. 1 year OR min. 4 years as Senior Manager. Desirable: ALM/Interest Rate Risk/Liquidity Risk management.
AGM - Digital Risk & Analytics (Scale V) Full-time Bachelor's in Mathematics/Statistics OR B.E./B.Tech in Data Science/IT/CS/Software Engineering. Preferred: MBA/PGDM/PGDBM/PGDBA in Finance OR PG in Statistics/Mathematics/Economics/Econometrics. Preferred: FRM by GARP, RAI by GARP, PRM (PRMIA), CFA, CQF, any Certification in ML/AI/NLP/Web Crawling/Neural Networks. Minimum 10 years in Banking (Officer Cadre), out of which minimum 5 years in Risk Management in scheduled commercial banks having more than 2000 branches. Current role must be Chief Manager with min. 1 year OR min. 4 years as Senior Manager. Desirable: Digital Risk/Vendor Risk/IT Risk/Model Validation.
AGM - Finance & Accounts (Scale V) Mandatory: Full-time Graduation AND must have passed final exam conducted by ICAI and enrolled as member of ICAI (Chartered Accountant). CA membership mandatory. Minimum 10 years in Scheduled Commercial Bank having more than 2000 branches, out of which minimum 7 years at Bank's Head Office/Administrative Office handling Corporate Taxation, GST, TDS, Balance Sheet, IFRS, Ind AS, Regulatory Reporting, Capital Raising. Current role must be Chief Manager with min. 1 year OR min. 4 years as Senior Manager.
AGM - Credit Officer (Scale V) Chartered Accountant / CFA / CMA-ICWA from recognized institute OR Two Years Full-time Post Graduation in Banking/Finance/any credit related field from recognized university/institution/board. As per qualification above. Minimum 10 years post qualification experience as an officer, out of which 7 years in Corporate Credit/Project Finance/Mid & Large Credit in Scheduled Public/Private Sector Banks having more than 2000 branches. Current role must be Chief Manager with min. 1 year OR min. 4 years as Senior Manager.

Age limit for all posts is Minimum 33 years and Maximum 45 years as on 31-03-2026. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India guidelines as follows:

AGM - Asset Liability Management (Scale V) Min 33 years - Max 45 years
AGM - Digital Risk & Analytics (Scale V) Min 33 years - Max 45 years

Ex-Servicemen (with at least 5 years military service) 5 years

Central Bank of India AGM Specialist Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Application fees / intimation charges are payable online from 30-04-2026 to 17-05-2026. The fee once paid is non-refundable. Bank transaction charges for online payment will have to be borne by the candidate.

Category Amount (inclusive of GST)
SC / ST / PwBD (Divyangjan) / Women Candidates Rs. 175/- (Intimation Charges only)
All Other Candidates (General / OBC / EWS) Rs. 850/- (Application Fee + Intimation Charges)

Central Bank of India AGM Specialist Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process consists of an Online Examination followed by an Interview. Merely satisfying the eligibility norm does not entitle a candidate to be called for the test or interview. Candidates qualified in the online test will be called for interview to the extent of 4 times the number of vacancies. Final merit will be based on the combined performance in Online Test and Interview in the ratio of 70:30. In case of equal marks, candidates senior in age will be placed higher in the merit list.

Online Examination Structure:

Sr. No. Name of Test No. of Questions Maximum Marks Duration
1 Stream/Category Specific Questions 70 70 Composite time of 60 minutes
2 Banking, Present Economic Scenario & General Awareness 30 30
Total 100  

Qualifying Marks

Category Qualifying Marks - Written Test Qualifying Marks - Interview
General / EWS 50% 50%
SC / ST / OBC / PwBD (Divyangjan) 45% 45%

Selection Weightage

Online Test : Interview Weightage 70 : 30
No. of candidates called for Interview 4 times the number of vacancies (category-wise)
Negative Marking No penalty for wrong answers

How to Apply for Central Bank of India AGM Specialist Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply only online from 30-04-2026 to 17-05-2026 at the link https://ibpsreg.ibps.in/cbiagmapr26/. No other mode of application will be accepted. Before applying, candidates should scan their photograph (200x230 pixels, 20-50 KB), signature (140x60 pixels, 10-20 KB), left thumb impression (240x240 pixels, 20-50 KB), and handwritten declaration (800x400 pixels, 50-100 KB). A valid personal email ID and contact number must be kept active till completion of the recruitment process. Not more than one application should be submitted by any candidate. In case of multiple applications, only the latest valid (completed) application will be retained.

An indemnity bond of INR 3,00,000/- must be executed by the selected candidate to indemnify the Bank in case such candidate leaves the service within 3 years of selection. Candidates must have a minimum CIC (Credit Information Company) score of 650 with no credit default or financial indiscipline as on the date of document verification.

Documents to be Produced at the Time of Interview (Original + Self-attested copies):

  • Original Marks Sheet & Provisional Certificate / Degree Certificate issued from University
  • Experience Certificates as per eligibility requirements
  • Caste / PwBD (Divyangjan) / Caste Validity Certificate (wherever applicable)
  • OBC Certificate with Non-Creamy Layer clause (for OBC candidates)
  • EWS Income and Asset Certificate (for EWS candidates)
  • No Objection Certificate from employer (for candidates serving in Govt./PSU/Nationalized Banks)
  • Colour passport size photograph (same as uploaded in application form)

Apply Online at: https://ibpsreg.ibps.in/cbiagmapr26/

Important Instructions for Central Bank of India AGM Specialist Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only one application per candidate - multiple applications will result in forfeiture of fee paid for other registrations.
  • Applications once submitted cannot be withdrawn and fee once paid is neither refunded nor held in reserve.
  • Candidates must ensure eligibility before applying - the Bank reserves the right to reject applications at any stage.
  • Minimum CIC score of 650 is mandatory with no credit default in the credit report.
  • Indemnity bond of INR 3,00,000/- must be executed if selected (valid for 3 years of service).
  • Probation period of 2 years from the date of joining.
  • Initial posting will be at Mumbai and thereafter transferable anywhere in India as per bank's transfer policy.
  • Government/PSU/Nationalized Bank employees must produce NOC from employer at the time of interview.
  • OBC candidates in 'Creamy Layer' will be treated as 'General Category'.
  • No Travelling Allowance is payable to candidates called for interview. However, unemployed SC/ST candidates will be paid 2nd Class Rail/Ordinary Bus fare on production of travel evidence.
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  • Any resulting dispute shall be subject to the sole jurisdiction of Courts situated at Mumbai.
  • Candidates are advised to regularly visit the Bank's website www.centralbank.bank.in for updates under Career section.
  • All decisions of the Bank regarding eligibility, selection, and other matters are final and binding on all candidates.

  4. Register / Create account: Sign up using your valid email ID and active mobile number. Keep your Aadhaar, bank account details, and email accessible.

  8. Submit and save confirmation: Review all details before final submission. After submitting, download the application printout / PDF confirmation with your registration number. Store it safely for admit card, exam, and future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions – Sarkari Job 2026

What is Sarkari Job (सरकारी नौकरी)?

Sarkari Job (सरकारी नौकरी) refers to government employment in India — jobs offered by central government departments, state governments, public sector undertakings (PSUs), banks, railways, defence forces, and other government-funded organisations. These jobs offer permanent employment, fixed salary as per 7th Pay Commission, pension, medical benefits, and unmatched job security.

How to find Sarkari Job vacancy 2026 online?

To find online Sarkari Job vacancies in 2026: (1) Visit OnlyJobs daily for updated notifications. (2) Filter by your qualification — 10th, 12th, Graduate, PG. (3) Filter by sector — Railway, Banking, SSC, Defence, State PSC, Teaching. (4) Check last dates carefully. (5) Apply through the official department website using the direct link provided. Enable push notifications on OnlyJobs for instant alerts.

What Sarkari Job can I get after 10th pass?

After 10th pass, you can apply for: Railway Group D (RRB), Indian Army Soldier posts, Postal Mail Guard, SSC MTS / Havaldar, Constable GD, Anganwadi Worker/Helper, ITI Apprentice in PSUs (IOCL, HPCL, NTPC), MCL / Coal India posts, and various state government peon/chowkidar posts. Thousands of 10th pass Sarkari Job vacancies open every year.

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 – FAQ's

How to apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 online?

Visit your state's official WCD / ICDS portal (link provided in table above). Register with mobile & Aadhaar, fill the application form, upload documents (photo, 10th certificate, Aadhaar, domicile), and submit before the last date. Print the application acknowledgement slip after submission.

What is the eligibility for Anganwadi Worker 2026?

Candidates must have passed 10th or 12th standard from a recognized board. Age limit is 18–35 years (varies by state). Must be a permanent resident of the ward/village for which vacancy exists. Only female candidates are eligible for Worker and Helper posts.

What is the salary of Anganwadi Worker in 2026?

Anganwadi Worker receives a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000–₹20,000 depending on the state (Karnataka and TN are highest at ~₹14,000). Anganwadi Helper gets ₹5,000–₹7,000/month. The Central Government pays ₹4,500/month as base honorarium, and states add their own component on top.

Is there a written exam for Anganwadi jobs?

No, there is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Selection is purely merit-based on academic qualification marks (10th / 12th percentage). For Supervisor / CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted depending on the state.

What is the age limit for Anganwadi Helper?

Age limit is 18 to 35 years as of 1st January 2026 in most states. SC/ST candidates get 5 years relaxation (maximum age 40). OBC candidates get 3 years relaxation (maximum age 38). PwD candidates get additional relaxation as per state rules.

What documents are required for Anganwadi job application?

Required documents: Aadhaar card, 10th/12th marksheet and certificate, domicile/residence certificate, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), passport-size photograph, scanned signature, and EWS/PwD certificate if applicable. Graduation certificate is needed for Supervisor post applications.

What is ICDS recruitment 2026?

ICDS stands for Integrated Child Development Services - the government programme under which Anganwadi centres operate nationwide. ICDS recruitment 2026 refers to hiring of Anganwadi Workers, Helpers, Supervisors, and CDPOs by state WCD departments under the Ministry of Women & Child Development (wcd.nic.in).

Is Anganwadi Worker a permanent government job?

Anganwadi Workers and Helpers are honorary workers, not regular government employees. They receive a fixed monthly honorarium (not salary) and are entitled to benefits like ESI, health insurance, and maternity benefits. Supervisors and CDPOs are regular government employees in most states and receive full pay & grade pay.

Can I apply for Anganwadi job from a different district?

No. Anganwadi Workers and Helpers must be permanent residents of the same ward/village/district where the vacancy exists. A domicile or residence certificate is mandatory. Applications from outside the specified locality are rejected. For Supervisor/CDPO posts, the same district residency rule generally applies.

Most forest department recruitment notifications on this page focus on Forest Guard, Forester, Forest Range Officer, Field Guard and similar Group B, C and D posts.

Eligibility for Forest Department Jobs

Eligibility for forest department jobs depends on the post, state and recruitment authority. Below is a general idea of qualification and age for popular posts like Forest Guard, Forester and Forest Range Officer. Candidates should always check the official notification for detailed eligibility criteria.

Education Qualification for Forest Guard, Forester, Ranger

  • Forest Guard / Field Guard / Forest Watcher / Beat Guard: Usually 10th pass or 12th pass from a recognized board, knowledge of local language, and basic physical standards as per state rules.
  • Forester / Section Forest Officer / Deputy Forest Ranger: Generally 12th pass or graduate in any stream or science-related subjects, with physical standards and sometimes driving or technical skills depending on the post.
  • Forest Range Officer (RFO) / Forest Ranger / ACF: Normally graduate degree in Science, Agriculture, Forestry, Environmental Science, Engineering or related disciplines, with higher physical standards and sometimes a competitive exam similar to state PCS level.
  • IFS / Indian Forest Service and senior posts (DCF, CF, CCF, PCCF): Filled through UPSC Indian Forest Service Examination and promotions, requiring a graduate degree and all-India competitive selection.

Age Limit & Relaxation

  • Forest Guard / Forester / Field Guard: Minimum age is usually 18 years and maximum age is around 27–30 years, with age relaxation for SC, ST, OBC, EWS, Ex-servicemen and other categories as per government rules.
  • Forest Range Officer / ACF and higher competitive posts: Age limit often ranges from 21 to 32 years (varies by recruitment), with relaxations for reserved categories.
  • Exact age limit, cut-off date and relaxation details always depend on the particular notification, so candidates should verify from the official advertisement before applying.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern

The selection process for Forest Department Jobs 2026 typically includes written examinations, physical tests and document verification. Some posts also conduct medical examination and walking tests due to the demanding nature of field duties.

Written Exam, PET/PST & Document Verification

  • Written Exam: Most Forest Guard, Forester and Forest Range Officer recruitments start with a written exam based on objective-type questions (MCQs).
  • PET / PST (Physical Efficiency Test / Physical Standard Test): Candidates who qualify written exam are called for running, walking test, height, chest measurement and other physical parameters as per post and gender.
  • Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates must produce original certificates of age, qualification, caste, residence, sports/NCC and other documents mentioned in the notification.
  • Medical Examination: Many forest posts require medical fitness to ensure candidates can perform field duties in forests, wildlife areas and difficult terrain.

Syllabus Highlights for Forest Guard & Ranger

Typical syllabus for written exam may include:

  • General Knowledge & Current Affairs (national, state-level, environment and forest-related topics)
  • General Hindi / English or regional language (grammar, comprehension, vocabulary)
  • General Mathematics / Quantitative Aptitude (up to 10th or 12th level)
  • General Science and Environmental Studies (forest, wildlife, biodiversity, conservation, climate, basic biology)
  • Reasoning Ability (logical and analytical reasoning)

Exact subject-wise marks, number of questions, negative marking and exam duration will be given in the respective forest department notification.

How to Apply for Forest Department Jobs 2026

Most Forest Department Jobs 2026 applications are accepted either online through official websites or offline via prescribed application forms. Candidates should carefully read the official notification before filling the form.

Online Application Process

  1. Visit the official website of the recruiting body (State Forest Department, State PSC, Staff Selection Board or other government portal).
  2. Find the latest link for Forest Guard / Forester / Forest Range Officer / other forest posts and open the detailed advertisement.
  3. Complete the registration process with basic details like name, mobile number, email ID and verify using OTP if required.
  4. Fill the online application form with personal, educational, address and category information exactly as per documents.
  5. Upload scanned copies of photograph, signature and other certificates in the prescribed format and size.
  6. Pay the application fee online through Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI as per your convenience.
  7. Finally, submit the form and take a printout or PDF of the submitted application and payment receipt for future reference.

Documents Required & Application Fee

  • Recent passport size photograph and signature (scanned)
  • Class 10th and 12th mark sheets and certificates
  • Degree / Diploma certificates for graduate-level posts
  • Caste / Category certificate (SC, ST, OBC, EWS, etc.)
  • Domicile / Residence certificate if required by the state
  • NCC, Sports, Ex-serviceman and other quota certificates if applicable
  • Valid ID proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN, Voter ID, Driving Licence, Passport, etc.)

Why Choose Forest Department Jobs?

Forest department jobs are popular among candidates who love nature, wildlife and field work. These jobs offer job security, government benefits and a chance to work in forest conservation, wildlife protection, eco-tourism and community development.

  • Stable government job with regular salary, pension/NPS and allowances
  • Opportunity to work in forests, wildlife sanctuaries, national parks and protected areas
  • Contribution to environment protection, afforestation and biodiversity conservation
  • Good promotion avenues from Forest Guard to Forester, Forest Range Officer and higher posts in many states.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Pay & Other Benefits

In addition to the consolidated monthly pay mentioned against each post, MECON offers a comprehensive benefits package to all contractual employees. Employees deployed at site/project locations receive a Site Allowance of 7.5% of pay, while those at Metro locations receive a Metro Allowance of 2.5% of pay. An annual increment on consolidated pay (rounded to the next ten rupees) is provided subject to company rules. Medical facilities including OPD and IPD treatment are available at Ispat Hospital, Ranchi, for employees posted at Ranchi (covering self, spouse, and 2 dependent children). For other locations, a company-retained doctor provides free consultation. Additionally, reimbursement of up to ₹15,000 per year towards Mediclaim premium (₹4,00,000 on floater basis) is available as per company policy.

Company accommodation (family or bachelor) may be provided based on availability at applicable charges; if not availed, HRA at 5% of consolidated pay is payable. Leave entitlements include Casual Leave (12 days/year), Earned Leave (18 days/year, accumulation up to 45 days), Half Pay Leave (14 days/year with commutation on medical certificate), and Maternity Leave as applicable to regular employees. National, Festival, and Restricted Holidays (4 nos.) are as per regular employee norms. All employees are covered under a Group Personal Accident Policy with a Sum Insured of ₹25 Lakhs.
