MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Definition of Work Experience

Work experience will be counted only if it is in a full-time job on a regular salary basis and in the relevant area as stipulated against the respective post. Intermittent or freelance experience will not be counted. Entrepreneurial experience is also not eligible. For Management Trainees, Executive Trainees, and Graduate Trainees, only the on-the-job training period served in PSUs will be counted towards experience. Articleship, internship, academic projects, teaching, and research experience will not be considered as post-qualification experience. However, the period of apprenticeship under the Apprenticeship Act will be counted towards the required post-qualification experience. All experience claimed must be substantiated with documentary evidence as specified; self-declarations regarding the nature of work or relevance of experience will not be accepted.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Documentary Evidence for Work Experience

Candidates must provide valid work experience certificates for all past employments mentioned in the application form. These certificates must clearly mention the date of joining, date of relieving, nature of duties, and specific areas of experience with relevance to the applied post. In the absence of a certificate from any past employer, the experience from that employer will not be counted, and the candidature may be rejected if minimum experience is not met. For current employment, candidates must submit an Experience Certificate or Offer/Appointment Letter along with Pay Slips for the last 3 months from the date of the advertisement. Identity Card proving continuity of employment may also be submitted. Non-submission of these documents may result in rejection. Aadhaar Card is mandatory and must be uploaded - any mismatch between the Aadhaar number entered online and the uploaded document will lead to summary rejection.

Employment Type Required Documents
Past Employment Experience certificate(s) with date of joining, date of relieving, nature of duties, and relevance to the applied post
Current Employment Experience Certificate OR Offer/Appointment Letter + Last 3 months Pay Slips + Identity Card (to prove continuity)

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit & Relaxation

The upper age limit for each post is 50 years for General (UR) and EWS category candidates, as calculated on the cut-off date of 23.03.2026. Age relaxation is provided as per Government of India guidelines. OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates get a relaxation of 3 years, SC/ST candidates get 5 years, and Persons with Disabilities (PwD) get relaxation of 10 years (General), 13 years (OBC-NCL), or 15 years (SC/ST).

Category Age Relaxation
General (UR) / EWS Upper Age Limit as per post (50 years for all posts in this recruitment)
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years relaxation
SC / ST 5 years relaxation
PwD - General (UR) 10 years relaxation
PwD - OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 13 years relaxation
PwD - SC / ST 15 years relaxation
J&K Domicile (01.01.1980 to 31.12.1989) 5 years relaxation
Ex-Servicemen As per extant Govt. of India guidelines

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Reservations & Relaxations

Reservations for SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), PwD (Persons with Disability - 40% or above), and EWS candidates are provided as per Government of India guidelines. Reservation for PwD is on a horizontal basis. SC, ST, and OBC (NCL) candidates applying against UR category posts will be considered on General category merit - no age relaxation or fee waiver applies to them in such cases. OBC (NCL) candidates must produce a valid certificate in the format prescribed by the Government of India; the certificate must not be more than 1 year old as on the date of advertisement. EWS candidates must produce an Income and Asset Certificate issued by the competent authority (such as District Magistrate, Revenue Officer not below Tehsildar rank, etc.) in the prescribed format available on MECON's website. The crucial date for the Income and Asset Certificate is the closing date for online applications.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Candidates applying under UR, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), or EWS category are required to pay a non-refundable application fee of ₹500 (Rupees Five Hundred only). Candidates belonging to SC, ST, PwD, or Ex-Servicemen categories, as well as internal MECON candidates, are fully exempted from paying any fee.

The application fee must be paid online through the payment gateway provided on MECON's official website. No other mode of payment (such as demand draft, postal order, or cash) is accepted. Once the fee is paid, candidates must click the "Verify" button to update the application status to "Submitted." Fee paid will not be refunded under any circumstances, so candidates are strongly advised to verify their eligibility before making payment. Applications submitted without fee or with insufficient fee will be rejected.

Category Application Fee
UR / OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) / EWS ₹500 (Non-Refundable)

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Selection Mode

The selection process for MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026 is through Walk-In-Interview. Walk-In-Interviews will be conducted at four locations - Delhi, Ranchi, Kolkata, and Bangalore - and the specific dates and times will be published on the MECON Careers page. Candidates must apply online before appearing for the interview.

On the date of the Walk-In-Interview, document scrutiny will be undertaken; if any claim in the application is found unsubstantiated, the candidate will not be allowed to appear for the interview and no TA will be reimbursed. The final list of selected candidates will be published on MECON's website and communicated via registered email ID only. MECON reserves the right to change the mode of selection at its discretion.

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Travelling Allowance (TA) for Interview

Outstation candidates who appear for the Walk-In-Interview are entitled to reimbursement of travelling allowance (TA) for to-and-fro travel by the shortest route from their mailing address (as mentioned in the application) to the interview venue. TA will be paid at III Tier AC (3A) / Chair Car (CC) rail fare rates, or ₹7 per km by road, whichever is less, subject to production of original tickets/receipts and/or boarding passes. Rail fare will be at regular (non-Tatkal/non-premium Tatkal) rates only. Internal MECON candidates will be governed by company service rules.

Candidates should note that scrutiny of applications is conducted on the interview date itself - if any claim is found unsubstantiated, the candidate will not be interviewed and no TA will be paid. TA forms must be submitted along with proof of travel, bank account number, and IFSC code of the bank branch for payment processing.

Grade Travelling Allowance
Contract III Tier A/C (3A) / CC by rail OR ₹7 per km by road - whichever is less, subject to production of ticket/receipt and/or boarding pass. Regular rail fare only (No premium/Tatkal).

MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026 - Place of Posting

The initial place of posting for each post code is as listed in the table below. Post Codes 01 to 23 are for Rampura Agucha Mines / Debari, Rajasthan; Post Codes 24 to 25 for Bangalore, Karnataka; Post Codes 26 to 27 for Bacheli, Chhattisgarh; Post Code 28 for Ranchi, Jharkhand; Post Codes 29 to 35 for Malanjkhand, Madhya Pradesh; and Post Codes 36 to 60 for Burnpur, West Bengal. Candidates should note that the initial place of posting is indicative only - MECON reserves the right to post selected candidates at any project site, location, or office of the company based on organizational requirements. Candidates must be prepared for transfers/postings anywhere in India as per management discretion.

How to Apply for MECON Limited FTFT Recruitment 2026

Applications for MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026 must be submitted online only through MECON's official website (www.meconlimited.co.in → Careers → Career Opportunities → Apply Online). No offline or postal applications will be accepted. Candidates must apply between 27 April 2026 and 11 May 2026. During the online application process, candidates must upload a recent passport-size colour photograph (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB), a signature image in blue/black ink (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB), and self-attested PDF copies of all required documents.

If multiple documents need to be merged, they must be combined into a single PDF not exceeding 1 MB. Aadhaar Card is mandatory and must be uploaded - any mismatch between the Aadhaar number entered online and the uploaded document will result in summary rejection. No modifications are allowed after submission of the online application, so candidates must take utmost care before final submission.

Government/PSU employees must forward their application through Proper Channel or produce an NOC at the time of the interview; failure to do so means they will not be interviewed and no TA will be paid. Hard copies of the online application and all required documents must be brought on the date of the Walk-In-Interview.

Documents to be uploaded online:

  • Recent passport-size colour photograph (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB)
  • Signature in blue/black ink (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB)
  • Matriculation/Secondary Board certificate or Municipal Birth Certificate (proof of age)
  • Final/Provisional Graduation and Post-Graduation certificates (as applicable)
  • All semester/year-wise mark sheets or consolidated mark sheet
  • Work experience certificates/documents as per Para 6 of the notification
  • PAN Card and Aadhaar Card
  • Caste certificate - OBC (NCL) / EWS / SC / ST (as applicable; OBC certificate not more than 1 year old)
  • PwD certificate in prescribed Govt. of India format (if applicable)
  • Income & Asset Certificate for EWS candidates as per DoPT OM No.36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) dated 31.01.2019
  • Discharge/Service Certificate (for Ex-Servicemen)
  • J&K Domicile Certificate (if applicable)
  • Meritorious Sportsperson Certificate (if applicable)

Important Instructions for MECON FTFT Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • All documents must be self-attested; third-party attestation is not required unless specifically mentioned.
  • Original certificates/documents must be produced at the time of the Walk-In-Interview.
  • No modifications are allowed after submission of the online application.
  • Government/PSU employees must produce NOC from present employer at interview.
  • Certificates in languages other than Hindi/English must be accompanied by a certified translation.
  • Candidates must maintain a valid and active email ID and mobile number for at least 1 year - all future communications will be through email only.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.
  • All disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of Ranchi (Jharkhand) only.
  • MECON's decision in all matters relating to recruitment will be final and binding.

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) Notification 2026 has been released on the official website upsc.gov.in. A total of 5 vacancies have been announced through the UPSC Recruitment 2026 for Assistant Professor, Scientific Officer and More Posts.

FOLLOW US

Candidates who have qualifications such as Master’s Degree in Physics, B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical/Metallurgical/Electrical/Civil Engineering, or M.E./M.Tech in relevant disciplines with required experience are eligible to apply for these vacancies. The online application process for UPSC Recruitment 2026 has started and will remain open until 15-05-2026.

Candidates can download the official notification PDF and apply online through the direct links provided below in this article.

Company Name Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)
Post Name Assistant Professor, Scientific Officer and More Posts
No of Posts 5
Advt No 03/2026
Salary Level 08-11 & Academic Level-10 in Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC
Qualification Master’s Degree in Physics, B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical/Metallurgical Engineering, B.E./B.Tech in Electrical/Mechanical/Metallurgy, Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering + M.E./M.Tech in Civil Engineering (Geo Informatics / Geoinformatics and Surveying Technology)
Age Limit Standard UPSC relaxations apply. Specific limits not provided.
Last Date 15-05-2026
Apply Mode Online
Job Type Full Time

UPSC Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF

Candidates who are interested in applying for the UPSC Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form.

UPSC Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

  • Scientist-B (Mechanical): A) Master’s Degree in Physics + 1 year practical experience in testing/calibration of engineering materials/products or precision measurements/metrology OR B) B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical/Metallurgical Engineering + 2 years practical experience in testing/calibration of engineering materials/products or precision measurements/metrology (in recognized lab/institute). Desirable: R&D experience in testing of engineering materials and metrology/calibration.
  • Scientific Officer (Non-Destructive): Master’s Degree in Physics OR B.E./B.Tech in Electrical/Mechanical/Metallurgy + 1 year experience in Non-Destructive testing Laboratory OR 1 year experience in X-Ray Diffraction or investigation of failure of Engineering Material by Non-Destructive and metallographic methods.
  • Superintending Archaeological Engineer: Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering + Eight years’ experience in Planning, Execution and Supervision of Civil Engineering works in Government Sector or Archaeological/Heritage Sites.
  • Assistant Professor, Civil Engineering (Survey): B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering + M.E./M.Tech in Civil Engineering (Geo Informatics / Geoinformatics and Surveying Technology) with first class or equivalent either at Bachelor’s or Master’s level.

  • All Posts: Standard UPSC relaxations apply. Specific age limits are not detailed in the provided data. Age relaxation details: OBC: +3 years; SC/ST: +5 years; PwBD: +10 years (max age not exceed 56 years); PwBD+OBC: +13 years; PwBD+SC/ST: +15 years; Central Govt. employees: +5 years; Ex-Servicemen: +5 years.

UPSC Recruitment 2026 - Salary

  • Scientist-B (Mechanical): Level-10 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC
  • Scientific Officer (Non-Destructive): Level-08 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC
  • Superintending Archaeological Engineer: Level-11 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC
  • Assistant Professor, Civil Engineering (Survey): Academic Level-10 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC

  • Recruitment Test (if decided by UPSC)

  • Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-05-2026.
  • To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has published the Stenographer Grade ‘C’ & ‘D’ Examination 2026 Notification on 24th April 2026. The recruitment drive aims to fill approximately 731 tentative vacancies for Stenographer Grade C (Group B Non-Gazetted) & Grade D (Group C) posts in various Ministries/Departments/Organizations of Govt. of India. Candidates aged 18-30 years (Grade C) / 18-27 years (Grade D) as on 01.08.2026, with 12th standard pass & stenography skills, are eligible to apply online only at ssc.gov.in from 24 April to 15 May 2026

FOLLOW US

SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

Staff Selection Commission (SSC), Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions, Govt. of India has released detailed advertisement (F. No. E1/32/026-C-2) for Stenographer Grade ‘C’ & ‘D’ posts across Ministries/Departments/Organizations including Attached/Subordinate offices & Statutory bodies. Download the official detailed notification from SSC website to check tentative vacancies (to be updated), eligibility, skill test standards, fee & application process before applying

SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Vacancy 2026

Approx. 731 tentative vacancies announced for Stenographer Grade C & D (exact post/category-wise to be updated on ssc.gov.in; State/Zone-wise vacancies not collected by SSC). Vacancies for ESM reserved only for Group C (Grade D). Updated vacancy details will be available on SSC website. Final vacancies: 232 Grade C + 1483 Grade D = 1715 (per some sources, subject to confirmation).

Note: No region-wise table provided in notification; check ssc.gov.in for updates.

SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Eligibility Criteria 2026

  • Nationality: Indian citizen / Subject of Nepal/Bhutan / Tibetan refugee (before 01.01.1962) / Person of Indian origin from specified countries (eligibility certificate required).

Essential Educational Qualification (as on 01.08.2026)

Post Name Educational Qualification
Stenographer Grade C & D 12th Standard or equivalent from recognized Board/University. Stenography skill mandatory (tested in Skill Test).

Crucial date: 01.08.2026 (born not before 02.08.1996 & not later than 01.08.2008 for Grade C; adjust for Grade D).

SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Application Fee 2026

  • For General / OBC (NCL) / EWS: ₹100/-

  • For SC / ST / PwBD / ESM / Women: No fee (exempted)

  • Pay online via BHIM UPI / Net Banking / Card

SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Selection Process 2026

  • Computer Based Test (CBT): 200 marks (objective; General Intelligence & Reasoning 50, GA 50, English 100); qualifying: 30% UR, 25% OBC/EWS, 20% others.

  • Skill Test in Stenography (Qualifying): Grade C: 100 wpm (English/Hindi); Grade D: 80 wpm (English/Hindi) (10 min dictation; 40% UR/EWS, 35% others pass marks).

  • Document Verification (DV) by User Departments.

  • Final Merit: Based on CBT marks (category-wise); All India Service Liability.

Pre-Employment Medical Exam (esp. for BRO posts with Physical Efficiency Test).

SSC Stenographer 2026 Documents Required

Candidates must upload/produce originals at DV:

  • Recent passport size photo & signature.

  • Matric certificate (DOB proof).

  • 12th mark sheet & certificate.

  • Caste/EWS/PwBD/ESM certificate (GOI format).

  • NOC (Govt./PSU employees).

  • ID proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID etc.).

  • Others (name change, scribe cert. if applicable).

How to Apply for SSC Stenographer 2026

  • Apply online only via ssc.gov.in → One Time Registration (OTR) → Stenographer 2026 section.

  • Capture live photo (webcam), upload signature (10-20 KB JPEG).

  • Fill details, pay fee (if applicable), submit.

  • Correction window: 20-21 May 2026 (charges apply).

  • Print application for records; active email/mobile required.

  • Last date: 15 May 2026 (23:59 Hrs)

SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Online Application Form

Eligible candidates apply online through SSC career portal from 24 April 2026 (evening). Complete OTR first, then application with photo/signature upload. Helpline: 1800-309-3063.

SSC Stenographer Grade C & D Remuneration 2026

Pay Component Details
Stenographer Grade C (post selection) Pay Level-7 (₹44,900 - 1,42,400); approx. CTC ₹10-12 LPA (incl. DA, HRA, perks).
Stenographer Grade D (post selection) Pay Level-4 (₹25,500 - 81,100); approx. CTC ₹6-8 LPA (incl. DA, HRA, perks). 
Additional Benefits DA, HRA/quarters, TA, medical, PF, gratuity, pension, leave encashment etc. as per rules.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Read notification carefully before applying.

  • Ensure eligibility (esp. stenography skill, age/EQ cut-off 01.08.2026).

  • Upload clear photo/signature; Aadhaar authentication recommended.

  • Govt/PSU: NOC/undertaking required.

  • Keep email/mobile active; no fee refund.

  • SSC reserves right to modify/cancel; no waiting list (sliding mechanism for FRTA).

  • Posts AISL; BRO posts need physical/medical standards (males only for BRO Grade D).

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Age Limit

The age limit for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 is between 18 and 30 years, calculated as on the crucial date of 01.08.2026. SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Application Fee

The application fee for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 is ₹100 for General (UR), OBC, and EWS male candidates. Women candidates and candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), and Ex-Servicemen eligible for reservation are fully exempted from payment of fee.

Fee can be paid online only through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or by using Visa, MasterCard, Maestro, or RuPay Debit Card. The fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances and will not be adjusted against any other examination. Candidates must ensure their fee payment is complete - if the fee is not received by SSC, the application status will show as "Incomplete" and will be summarily rejected.

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Scheme of Examination

The SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 will consist of two papers. Paper-I is a Computer Based Examination with objective-type multiple choice questions, divided into two sections - General Hindi and General English - each carrying 100 marks with a sectional timer of 1 hour. There is a negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in Paper-I.

Based on performance in Paper-I, candidates will be shortlisted category-wise to appear in Paper-II, which is a descriptive paper testing translation and essay writing skills in both Hindi and English, carrying 200 marks. Marks scored in Paper-I will be normalized if the exam is held in multiple shifts. Tentative Answer Keys will be uploaded after the exam, and candidates can submit online representations within the given time on payment of ₹50 per question (non-refundable).

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Selection Process

The selection process for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 consists of two stages. In the first stage, Paper-I (Computer Based Examination) is used to shortlist candidates category-wise for Paper-II. Minimum qualifying marks in Paper-I are 30% for UR, 25% for OBC/EWS, and 20% for all other categories. In the second stage, Paper-II (Descriptive) is conducted for shortlisted candidates.

For the final merit list, 50% weightage is given to Paper-I scores and 100% weightage to Paper-II marks. Final selection and allocation of Ministry/Department/Organization is based on merit-cum-preference of posts/departments exercised by candidates through an Online Option Form. In case of a tie, it is resolved by total marks in Paper-II, then date of birth (older preferred), and finally alphabetical order of names. Selected candidates will be on probation for 2 years and all posts carry All India Service Liability (AISL).

Stage Details
1. Paper-I (CBE) Objective type; used for shortlisting category-wise candidates for Paper-II. Minimum qualifying marks: UR 30%, OBC/EWS 25%, Others 20%
2. Paper-II (Descriptive) Translation passages (Hindi ↔ English) and Essay; 200 marks; qualifying based on Paper-I merit
3. Final Merit 50% weightage of Paper-I + 100% weightage of Paper-II marks
4. Post Preference & Allocation Online Option Form to be submitted before FRTA; merit-cum-preference based allocation
5. Document Verification Conducted by User Departments/Organizations after declaration of final result

Tie-Breaking Order

1st Higher total marks in Paper-II
2nd Date of Birth - older candidate preferred
3rd Alphabetical order of names of candidates

How to Apply for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026

The application process for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 is entirely online at https://ssc.gov.in. Candidates who have not yet completed their One-Time Registration (OTR) on the new SSC website must do so first, as the earlier OTR from the old website (ssc.nic.in) is not valid for the new portal. Aadhaar-based biometric authentication is available and recommended - candidates who opt for it will not face rejection on grounds of photograph or signature quality.

The application module is designed to capture a live photograph of the candidate through webcam or mobile device; pre-existing photographs must not be submitted. Candidates must also upload their scanned signature in JPEG/JPG format (10-20 KB). Applications with blurred or miniature photographs or signatures will be summarily rejected unless Aadhaar authentication has been opted for. Only one online application per candidate is permitted during the normal application period.

  • Visit the official website https://ssc.gov.in and complete One-Time Registration (OTR).
  • Login using Registration Number and Password.
  • Click on "Apply" under "Combined Hindi Translators Examination, 2026" in the Live Exam tab.
  • Fill in educational details, additional information (ESM/age relaxation), and examination centre preferences (up to 3 centres).
  • Capture live photograph through webcam/mobile as per instructions (no cap, mask, or spectacles).
  • Upload scanned signature in JPEG/JPG format (10-20 KB), dimensions ~6.0 cm (W) × 2.0 cm (H).
  • PwBD/PwD candidates must upload Disability Certificate as per Annexure-I/IA/X/XI, whichever is applicable.
  • Preview the application carefully, complete the declaration, and submit before 14.05.2026 (23:00 hours).
  • Pay the application fee (if applicable) online through BHIM UPI, Net Banking, or Debit Card on or before 15.05.2026 (23:00 hours).
  • Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference.

SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 Application Form

Eligible candidates who wish to apply for the SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 can do so by submitting their application form online only. The application process is entirely online, and candidates must ensure they complete all steps including OTR, form filling, photograph/signature upload, and fee payment before the respective closing dates.

The application form is accessible through the official SSC website after completing One-Time Registration. Candidates are strongly advised to fill the application carefully as only one application is accepted per candidate - multiple applications will lead to cancellation of candidature. Details such as name, father's name, mother's name, and date of birth must be filled exactly as they appear in the Matriculation Certificate. After final submission, modifications are only permitted during the correction window (19.05.2026 to 20.05.2026) on payment of correction charges.

Apply Online at: https://ssc.gov.in

Important Instructions for Candidates

Candidates applying for SSC Combined Hindi Translators Examination 2026 must read the official notification carefully in its entirety before filling and submitting the application form. The English version of the notice will prevail in case of any dispute. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the closing date to avoid last-minute server load issues on the SSC website. All candidatures are provisional - the Commission does not undertake detailed scrutiny at the time of the written examination, and eligibility will be verified only at the Document Verification stage by the User Departments. Any suppression or misrepresentation of information in the application can lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage, including after selection. Canvassing in any form will result in immediate disqualification. The decision of the Commission in all matters including eligibility, selection, and allocation of posts is final and binding.

  • Read the official notice carefully before applying; English version prevails in case of dispute.
  • Only one online application is permitted per candidate; multiple applications will be rejected.
  • Name, DOB, father's name, and mother's name must match the Matriculation Certificate exactly.
  • Candidates must keep a printout of their application for at least 3 years for future reference.
  • Post preference must be submitted online before FRTA declaration; options once submitted are final.
  • All posts carry All India Service Liability (AISL) - candidates may be posted anywhere in India.
  • Regularly check https://ssc.gov.in for updates on exam dates, vacancies, admit cards, and results.

RBI Grade B Officer Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

RBI Grade B Officer Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for RBI Grade B Recruitment 2026 consists of Phase-I Online Examination, Phase-II Online/Written Examination, and Interview. No candidate will be called for the Interview unless he/she appears in Phase-II examination. The final merit list will be prepared by adding marks secured in Phase-II and Interview (and grace marks as applicable). If a candidate remains absent in the Interview, his/her candidature will not be considered for final selection.

RBI Grade B Officer Recruitment 2026 - Exam Syllabus

Phase-I – General Cadre (200 Marks, Objective MCQ, 120 Minutes)

The paper covers General Awareness, English Language, Quantitative Aptitude, and Reasoning. Separate time will be allotted for each section. Detailed information will be provided in the Information Handout available with the Admit Card.

Phase-II – General Cadre

Paper-I (Economic and Social Issues): Growth and Development (National Income, poverty alleviation, sustainable development); Indian Economy (economic history, monetary and fiscal policy since 1991, Indian money and financial markets, public finance, agriculture, services sector); Globalization (BoP, export-import policy, IMF, World Bank, WTO); Social Structure in India (multiculturalism, demographic trends, urbanization, gender issues, social justice).

Paper-II (English – Writing Skills): Writing skills including expression and understanding of the topic.

Paper-III (General Finance and Management): Financial system (structure of financial institutions, RBI functions, banking system, digital payments); Financial markets (primary and secondary markets); General topics (financial risk management, derivatives, financial inclusion, corporate governance, Union Budget, accounting basics, inflation); Management (fundamentals, organizational behaviour, motivation, leadership, ethics, corporate governance, communication).

Phase-I – DEPR Cadre (Paper-I, Objective – Economics)

Microeconomics, Macroeconomics (IS-LM Model, schools of economic thought), International Economics, Theories of Economic Growth and Development, Public Finance, Environmental Economics, Quantitative Methods in Economics, Current developments in Indian Economy.

Phase-II – DEPR Cadre (Descriptive – Economics)

Paper-I covers Microeconomics Module (consumer theory, production theory, market theory, welfare economics) and Macroeconomics Module (national income accounting, employment and output, inflation, money and banking, growth theories, international trade, public finance) with equal weightage. Paper-II covers Quantitative Methods in Economics (mathematical methods, statistical methods, econometrics) and Indian Economy – Policy and Trends (fiscal policy, monetary policy, banking sector, inflation, external sector, sectoral developments) with equal weightage.

Phase-I – DSIM Cadre (Paper-I, Objective – Statistics) and Phase-II (Paper-II, Descriptive – Statistics)

Topics covered across both papers: Theory of Probability, Probability Distributions and Sampling Theory; Linear Models and Economic Statistics; Statistical Inference (Estimation, Testing of Hypothesis, Non-Parametric Tests); Stochastic Processes; Multivariate Analysis; Econometrics and Time Series; Optimization and Statistical Computing; Data Science, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Techniques; Database and Data Warehouse Management.

How to Apply for RBI Grade B Officer Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the Bank's website www.rbi.org.in. No other means/mode of application will be accepted. The online portal will be active from 29-04-2026 to 20-05-2026 (6:00 PM). Candidates desirous of applying for both Grade 'B' (DR)-General and Grade 'B' (DR)-DEPR or DSIM must apply using separate links and pay fees for both. Digi Locker has been integrated with the online application form for voluntary submission of credentials.

Candidates should avoid submitting multiple applications; if done unavoidably, only the application with the higher Registration ID (RID) will be considered valid, and fee paid against other RIDs will not be adjusted. After the closing date, a 2-day edit window will be available for making corrections in limited fields. Candidates are not required to upload supporting documents at the time of online application; documents will be verified at the Interview stage only.

Candidates working in Government/PSU/Public Enterprises must inform their employer in writing before applying and submit an undertaking to this effect at the time of online application. At the time of joining, proper discharge certificates from their employer must be produced.

Mode of Payment: Online only via Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking through the application portal. Payment through UPI is to be avoided. The fee is non-refundable.

PGIMER Recruitment 2026 - Reservation Criteria

SC/ST/OBC: Caste certificate issued by competent authority must be uploaded. OBC candidates must submit a Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) certificate issued between 01.04.2026 and 11.05.2026 (i.e., valid for financial year 2026-27) in the DoPT prescribed format. An additional declaration in Annexure-II must be submitted at document verification confirming non-creamy layer status.

EWS: Gross annual family income must be below ₹8 lakh for the financial year 2025-26. The family must not possess 5 acres or more of agricultural land, a residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, or a residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more in notified municipalities. Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure-III format) must be issued between 01.04.2026 and 11.05.2026 by a competent authority (District Magistrate, Tehsildar, SDO, etc.). SC/ST/OBC candidates are not eligible for EWS reservation.

PwBD: Minimum 40% benchmark disability is required for fee exemption and age relaxation. Disability certificate from a government-authorized authority is mandatory. Scribe/Reader facility is available for eligible PwBD candidates (blindness, both-arm locomotor disability, cerebral palsy), subject to advance intimation via the online application. Compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour of exam is allowed for scribe users.

PGIMER Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process is conducted in two stages for a combined total of 100 marks:

Stage 1 - Computer Based Test (CBT): 75 Marks

  • Date: 22.05.2026
  • Duration: 50 minutes
  • Pattern: 50 objective-type questions × 1.5 marks each = 75 marks
  • Negative marking: 0.25 marks per wrong answer
  • Syllabus: Based on prescribed educational qualification and professional course content for each post/speciality
  • Minimum qualifying marks: 40% for General/EWS; 35% for SC/ST/OBC

Stage 2 - Departmental Interview & Assessment: 25 Marks

  • Date (Expected): 23.06.2026
  • Based on clinical evaluation, laboratory testing, structured viva, or personal interview as applicable
  • Minimum qualifying marks: 40% for General/EWS; 35% for SC/ST/OBC

Candidates are shortlisted after CBT in the ratio of 1:3 (three candidates per advertised post), category-wise and department-wise. Eligibility notice will be published on 16.06.2026. Only candidates appearing in the Eligibility Notice will be called for document verification and interview.

Final Merit: Aggregate of CBT (75 marks) + Departmental Interview (25 marks) for candidates who qualify both stages separately.

Tie-Breaking (in order):

  1. Fewer wrong answers / less negative marking in CBT
  2. Date of birth (older candidate ranked higher)
  3. Higher aggregate percentage in 10+2
  4. Higher aggregate percentage in Matric/10th standard

Examination Centres: Chandigarh (Tricity), Delhi/NCR, Hyderabad, Kolkata. City preference is on a first-come-first-served basis and once allotted, cannot be changed.

PGIMER Recruitment 2026 - How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website: www.pgimer.edu.in and click on the Recruitment link on the Home Page.
  2. Register with mandatory details — name (as per matriculation), date of birth, mobile number, and email ID. Registration details cannot be changed once submitted.
  3. Log in using the User ID and password sent to your registered email and mobile number.
  4. Fill the Online Application Form section-by-section carefully. All entries are final on submission.
  5. Upload mandatory documents — educational certificates (from Matric onwards with mark sheets), MCI/DCI registration certificate, category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD), NOC from present employer (if applicable), and passport-size photograph.
  6. Pay the application fee online via Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking.
  7. Take a printout of the final application form and e-Challan for future reference.

Photograph Instructions:

  • Clear passport-size colour photograph with light background in JPEG format, size 50-80 KB.
  • Must be taken on or after 01.03.2026.
  • Candidate's name and date of photograph must be written clearly on the photo.
  • No cap or goggles; spectacles are permitted.
  • Photo must be unattested on the application form.

Important: A candidate can apply for one department only. Applying for more than one department will result in rejection of all applications. No change in category or department is permitted after submission. Duplicate applications will be summarily rejected.

PGIMER Recruitment 2026 - Documents Required at Document Verification

  • Printout of online application form
  • e-Challan (fee payment proof)
  • Educational certificates and mark sheets from Matric onwards
  • MCI/DCI registration certificate
  • Caste/category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD)
  • Fresh OBC certificate (issued from 01.04.2026 onwards)
  • OBC declaration (Annexure-II) — for OBC candidates
  • NOC from present employer (if currently employed)
  • All original documents corresponding to uploaded copies

PGIMER Recruitment 2026 - Likely Causes for Rejection

  • Submitting more than one application for the same post
  • Incomplete or offline application
  • Non-payment or incorrect payment of fee
  • Applicant does not meet required qualification on the cutoff date
  • Required documents not uploaded with the application
  • Overage or underage on the closing date
  • Absence of visible identification mark in the application form
  • Photograph not meeting prescribed specifications

Before applying for Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026, candidates must ensure they meet all the prescribed eligibility conditions including educational qualification, experience, and other requirements for the respective post. Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Selection Process 2026

The selection process for Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026 involves scrutiny of applications, written test, and skill/practical/physical test wherever applicable. All applications will be scrutinised in terms of age limit, minimum qualification, documents and certificates. Eligible candidates will be issued call letters for the written test.

The written test will be based on minimum education qualification. Shortlisted candidates will then be called for skill/practical/physical test wherever applicable. Merely fulfilling basic selection criteria does not automatically entitle a person to be called for test. Selected candidates will be subject to "All India Service Liability". The detailed selection process is given below.

Stage Details
1. Scrutiny of Applications Pre-scrutiny in terms of age limit, minimum qualification, documents and certificates by the respective unit before calling candidates for the written test
2. Written Test 100% weightage; Question cum answer paper will be in English and Hindi; there will be simultaneous conduct of test for all categories
3. Skill / Practical / Physical Test Qualifying in nature; required candidates shortlisted based on merit/category in written test will be called for this test

Post Syllabus

Civilian Mechanical Transport Driver (CMTD) General Intelligence & Reasoning, Numerical Aptitude, General English, General Awareness and Trade/Post related questions

How to Apply for Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026

The application process for Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026 is strictly offline. Eligible candidates can apply to any of the Air Force Stations of their choice subject to the vacancies and qualifications. The application as per Annexure-I, duly supported with required documents, must reach the concerned Air Force Station as per choice within 30 days from the date of publication of this advertisement in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar. The step-by-step process to apply offline is given below.

  • Download and fill the Application Form as per the prescribed Proforma (Annexure-I) given in the advertisement. The application form must be filled/typed in English or Hindi.
  • Affix a recent passport-size self-attested photograph on the application form. Also attach two passport-size photographs (same as affixed on the form).
  • Attach self-attested copies of all documents in support of educational qualification, age, technical qualification, Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) certificate (if applicable), experience certificate, and Caste Certificate issued by the competent civil authorities in case of SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates.
  • In case of appointment of OBC candidates against reserved quota, their caste should be listed under Central List of OBCs. OBC candidates seeking reservation must submit a certificate to the effect that he/she does not belong to the creamy layer.
  • In case of ex-serviceman, a self-attested photocopy of the discharge book must be submitted along with the application.
  • EWS candidates must ensure that the Income & Asset Certificate is valid for Financial Year 2026-2027 (issued on the basis of income for Financial Year 2025-2026).
  • Attach a self-addressed envelope with stamps of Rs. 10/- pasted. Address should be typed in English/Hindi.
  • Mention clearly on the envelope: "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ________ AND CATEGORY ________"
  • Send the complete application by post to the concerned Air Force Station/Unit's postal address within 30 days from the date of publication of this advertisement.
  • Candidates intending to apply for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post.

Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Application Form 2026

The application must be duly filled, supported with all required self-attested documents, and sent by post to the concerned Air Force Station/Unit within 30 days from the date of publication in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar.

RRB Group D Eligibility Criteria 2026 – Quick Overview

Here are the key points at a glance:

  • Minimum Education: 10th pass (Matriculation) from a recognized board, or ITI from NCVT/SCVT, or National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in relevant trade.

  • Age Range: Generally 18–33 years (calculated as on the cutoff date mentioned in the notification, such as 01.01.2026).

  • Nationality Requirement: Primarily Indian citizens; certain other categories like subjects of Nepal/Bhutan or specified migrants are eligible with proper certificates.

  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Medical Standards: Mandatory qualifying stages after CBT.

  • Category-wise Age Relaxation: Available for OBC, SC/ST, Ex-servicemen, PwBD, and others as per rules.

RRB Group D Educational Qualification 2026

The minimum educational qualification for RRB Group D 2026 requires candidates to have:

  • Passed Class 10/Matriculation from a recognized board, or

  • ITI certificate from NCVT/SCVT in a relevant trade, or

  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) granted by NCVT.

Equivalence like NIOS/open schooling is generally accepted if recognized and mentioned in the official notification—always verify the exact clause in the CEN PDF. Final-year or appearing candidates are typically not eligible; the qualification must be completed by the application closing date.

Common doubts:

  • Gap years or backlogs do not disqualify if the certificate is obtained.

  • Subject stream usually does not matter for non-technical posts.

  • Always cross-check with the official notification to avoid issues.

RRB Group D Age Limit 2026

The general age limit for RRB Group D 2026 is 18 to 33 years, calculated as on the date specified in the notification (e.g., 01.01.2026). Candidates must fall within this range before applying.

RRB Group D Nationality Criteria 2026

Under RRB Group D nationality criteria, candidates must be:

  • A citizen of India, or

  • A subject of Nepal or Bhutan, or

  • A Tibetan refugee who came to India before January 1, 1962 (with intent to settle permanently), or

  • A person of Indian origin migrated from specified countries (Pakistan, Burma, etc.) with an eligibility certificate from the Government of India.

Most applicants qualify as Indian citizens.

RRB Group D Physical Eligibility & PET 2026

The RRB Group D physical standards include two stages: PET (qualifying) and medical examination.

Physical Efficiency Test (PET) Requirements

PET is qualifying (pass/fail) and conducted for shortlisted CBT candidates. Typical requirements (as per notification; may vary slightly):

  • Male candidates: Running a specified distance in given time, lifting/carrying weight over distance.

  • Female candidates: Adjusted distance/weight parameters.

Only those passing PET proceed further.

RRB Group D Medical Standards 2026

The medical exam follows document verification and includes vision (distant/near), color vision, blood pressure, cardiac, hearing, and general fitness checks. Posts fall under A-2, B-1, C-1, etc., categories candidates must meet the standards for allotted posts.

Common disqualifying reasons include poor eyesight beyond limits, uncontrolled chronic conditions, or major disabilities incompatible with duties. Exact conditions are in the official rules.

Important Documents Required for RRB Group D Eligibility Verification

Candidates need these for various stages (especially document verification):

  • 10th/Matriculation certificate and mark sheet.

  • ITI/NAC certificate (if applicable).

  • Category certificates (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS in central format).

  • PwBD certificate (if claiming).

  • Ex-servicemen discharge certificate.

  • Photo ID (Aadhaar, Voter ID, etc.).

  • Passport-size photographs (per specs).

Who Is Not Eligible for RRB Group D 2026?

  • Candidates below 18 or above 33 years (even after relaxation).

  • Those without required 10th/ITI/NAC by cutoff date.

  • Non-eligible nationality or missing certificates.

  • Failing PET or medical exam.

  • Incomplete, incorrect, or forged documents.

  • Debarred by RRB or with disqualifying background (if specified).

RITES Individual Consultant Selection Process 2026

Stage Details
1. Online Application & Document Upload Candidates apply online via RITES website and upload all required documents (education, experience, ID proofs, etc.) in the portal; hard copies are not to be sent by post.
2. Document Scrutiny / Verification All applicants who submit the online form are provisionally allowed for document scrutiny; eligibility against the post is verified from uploaded documents and original proofs (in person/online).
3. Shortlisting Only candidates found eligible after document scrutiny are shortlisted for interview; RITES reserves the right to limit the number of candidates.
4. Interview (Personal) Mode of selection is Interview only; candidates are evaluated on technical skills, subject knowledge, experience, communication and interpersonal skills.
5. Client CV Approval & Engagement CVs of suitable candidates are sent to client; engagement letters issued only for candidates whose CVs are approved by client and subject to project/award requirements.

How to Apply for RITES Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026

  • Visit the RITES official website https://www.rites.com and open the “Career” section, then the relevant online registration link for Individual Consultant posts (VC Nos. YP/16/26–YP/38/26).
  • Carefully read the detailed advertisement and ensure that you meet the required educational qualification, post-qualification experience and age criteria for the specific VC number/post.
  • Fill the online application (registration format) with accurate personal details, educational qualifications, experience, category and identity proof details; note and preserve the system-generated Registration No. for all future communication.
  • Upload scanned copies of required documents: photograph, High School certificate (DOB), all marksheets and degree/diploma certificates (X, XII, Diploma, Graduation, Post-Graduation, PhD), experience certificates, relieving/NOC for Govt./PSU employees, ID proofs (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport/Voter ID/Driving Licence), and any additional supporting documents, in clear, legible format.
  • Print and sign the submitted online Application Form containing Registration No.; keep it ready along with self-attested photocopies for document verification/interview.
  • At the time of document verification/interview (in-person or online), present all original documents along with one self-attested set and duly filled Annexure-A (document checklist).
  • Note that applications once submitted cannot be altered; candidates must ensure correctness and completeness before final submission.

Important Instructions for Candidates

Candidates must carefully check their eligibility for the specific VC number before applying and ensure that all claims made in the application are fully supported by valid documents.

Management reserves the right to cancel/modify/alter the selection/engagement process at any stage and to vary the number of vacancies without notice.

  • Any false/incomplete information or suppression of material facts will lead to rejection of candidature and termination of engagement if discovered later.
  • The period of training/internship is not counted as post-qualification experience; date of acquiring qualification is determined as per earliest of exam date/result/marksheet/degree issuance as defined in the notification.
  • Consultants are independent service providers, not regular staff; no TA/DA is admissible for joining or attending interview, and they are responsible for their own insurance.
  • Individual Consultants must avoid conflict of interest, maintain confidentiality under Official Secrets Act, and adhere to conduct standards including provisions related to sexual harassment.
  • RITES may terminate the contract at any time (normally with one month’s notice); consultants also must give one month’s notice to resign.
  • All recruitment-related communication and online interview links will be sent to the registered email ID; candidates should regularly check their email and RITES website for updates and FAQs.

Applications must be submitted online only through the official GMRCL website. No hard copy or offline applications will be accepted. Candidates are advised to complete the application process well before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues.

  • Take a printout of the final submitted application form and keep it safely along with the registration number and password.

  • For More Details Kindly See the Full Information Brochure or Read the Code Wise Eligibility Details.

NEET UG 2026 Age Limit

  • Minimum Age : 17 Years
  • Maximum Age : No Limit
  • born on or before 31.12.2009
  • Age Relaxation Extra as per Rules.
 

Eligibility Code for NTA NEET 2026 UG

  • NEET UG Code 01: A candidate who is appearing in the qualifying examination, i.e., 12 Standard in 2025 whose result is awaited may apply and take up the said test but he/she shall not be eligible for admission to the MBBS or BDS, if he/she does not pass the qualifying examination with the required pass percentage of marks at the time of first round of Counseling.
  • NEET UG Code 02 : The Higher/Senior Secondary Examination or the Indian School Certificate Examination which is equivalent to 10+2 Higher/Senior Secondary Examination after a period of 12 years study, the last two years of such study comprising of Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Bio-technology (which shall include practical tests in these subjects) and Mathematics or any other elective subject with English at a level not less than the core course for English as prescribed by the National Council of Educational Research and Training after introduction of the 10+2+3 educational structure as recommended by the National Committee on Education.
  • NEET UG Code 03 : The Intermediate/Pre-degree Examination in Science of an Indian University/Board or other recognized examining body with Physics, Chemistry, Biology /Bio-technology (which shall include practical test in these subjects) and also English as a compulsory subject
  • NEET UG Code 04 : The Pre-professional/Pre-medical Examination with Physics ,Chemistry, Biology/Bio-technology & English after passing either the Higher Secondary Examination or the Pre-University or an equivalent examination. The Pre-professional/Pre-medical examination shall include practical test in these subjects and also English as a compulsory subject.
  • NEET UG Code 05 : The first year of the three years’ degree course of a recognized University with Physics, Chemistry and Biology/Bio-technology including practical tests in these subjects provided the examination is a University Examination and candidate has passed the earlier qualifying examination with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Bio-Technology with English at a level not less than a core course.
  • NEET UG Code 06 : B.Sc.Examination of an Indian University provided that he/she has passed the B.Sc.Examination with not less than two of the subjects Physics, Chemistry, Biology (Botany, Zoology)/Bio-technology and further that he/she has passed the earlier qualifying examination with Physics,Chemistry,Biology and English.
  • NEET UG Code 07: Any other examination which in scope and standard (Last 02 years of 10+2 Study
    comprising of Physics, Chemistry and Biology/Biotechnology; which shall include
    practical test in these subjects) is found to be equivalent to the Intermediate Science
    Examination of an Indian University/Board, taking Physics, Chemistry and
    Biology/Biotechnology including practical tests in each of these subjects and English.

Role Snapshot

Founding Engineer (US)

Build the AI platform that's rewriting a $50B industry

Salary range - $180-220k USD + Equity + Benefits


About Haast

We're building one of the first agentic systems for enterprise legal and compliance teams that actually automates their manual work. End-to-end. Delivering 80% faster compliance reviews and 4x productivity gains.

We recently closed a $12M USD Series A (Peak XV Partners, DST Global, Airtree) and are growing fast in the US; building the infrastructure that will completely re-define how enterprises think about compliance.

Think Canva for design. Atlassian for projects. Haast for compliance.


The Problem

Compliance is a $50B global challenge. Enterprise legal and compliance teams spend a significant amount of time manually reviewing documents against policy, spotting regulatory risk, and signing off on content before go-to-market. It's painful and it's mission-critical.

We're building the infrastructure that makes this manageable at scale. You'll be working on systems that directly reduce risk and unlock productivity for some of the world's largest organisations.


The Role

As our first US based Engineer; you'll be the technical bridge between our product vision and our customers' reality.

You're a full-stack engineer who thrives at the intersection of innovation and execution, building our platform while staying connected to the teams actually using it.

You'll split your time between heads-down building (shipping code that matters) and being engaged with customers, understanding their pain points firsthand, iterating on features in real-time, and using that feedback to shape our product direction.

You'll own end-to-end technical decisions: designing systems, shipping to production, and iterating based on direct customer interaction.

This is high-autonomy work. You'll collaborate directly with our founding team, move at startup velocity, and have genuine influence over both our architecture and product roadmap.

What You'll Own

  • Design, architect, and ship full-stack features that directly solve our customers compliance challenges

  • Own the technical relationship with key customers; implementing solutions, gathering requirements, and translating feedback into product improvements

  • Build scalable services and APIs that power our LLM compliance platform while keeping the customer experience front and center

  • Make high-impact technical decisions quickly, knowing that you'll be accountable to both our engineering standards and our customers

  • Challenge assumptions on "why" and "how", you'll directly influence what we build and how we build it

  • Shape our product roadmap and engineering practices as we scale from Series A to market leadership

Who We're Looking For

  • You've built full-stack systems at meaningful scale; you're equally comfortable architecting backend services and shipping frontend code that customers interact with daily

  • You're deep on one or more of: Go, Node.js/TypeScript, or Python, and you're fluent enough across the stack to own features end-to-end

  • You understand APIs, distributed systems, and the tradeoffs between speed and reliability in production environments

  • You genuinely enjoy working with customers; you're not just shipping features, you want to understand the human problem you're solving

  • You've shipped in fast-moving environments and understand what it takes to move quickly without breaking things

  • You're curious about how LLMs work and excited about building practical applications on top of them, not just the theory

Why Join Haast

  • Competitive benefits: PTO, Health, Dental, Vision, 401k

  • Real impact, day one: Your code runs inside the workflows of major global enterprises immediately. You're solving mission-critical compliance problems that directly reduce risk and unlock productivity.

  • Forward-deployed influence: You'll spend time with customers, understanding their pain points and having direct input into product decisions. Your customer insights will shape our roadmap.

  • Equity upside: We're building a generational company in a $50B market. You'll own a meaningful stake in that value creation and be part of the defines how Haast scales. We believe in sharing success with the people who build it.

  • Exceptional learning velocity: You'll learn more about scaling systems, working with customers, building products, and navigating the demands of a fast-growing startup in 12 months here than most roles offer in three years.

  • Engineering-driven culture: No red tape. We hire smart people and get out of their way. Your voice matters in how we build.

  • Flexibility and community: Fully remote across the US or Canada.

How to Apply

We're looking for people who've shipped things they're proud of and want to work on a problem that genuinely matters.

Apply with:

  1. Your CV

  2. A brief note on this question: Tell us about a time you worked with customers to ship something they actually needed. What did it take to achieve the outcome?

No closing date. We review applications on a rolling basis.

At Haast, we believe bold ideas come from diverse perspectives. We're committed to building a team that reflects the world we work in. Even if you don't tick every box, we'd love to hear from you.
